quotes.quote: Friendship ... is born at the moment when one man says to another "What! You too? I thought that no one but myself . . .
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Four Loves

quotes.quote: Don't walk in front of me... I may not followDon't walk behind me... I may not leadWalk beside me... just be my friend
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: A friend is someone who knows all about you and still loves you.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: Good friends, good books, and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Outside of a dog, a book is man's best friend. Inside of a dog it's too dark to read.
quotes.author: Groucho Marx,  The Essential Groucho: Writings For By And About Groucho Marx

quotes.quote: It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

quotes.quote: If you live to be a hundred, I want to live to be a hundred minus one day so I never have to live without you.
quotes.author: Joan Powers,  Pooh's Little Instruction Book

quotes.quote: The truth is, everyone is going to hurt you. You just got to find the ones worth suffering for.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: There is no friend as loyal as a book.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: Piglet sidled up to Pooh from behind. "Pooh!"he whispered."Yes, Piglet?""Nothing,"said Piglet, taking Pooh's paw. "I just wanted to be sure of you.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne,  The House at Pooh Corner

quotes.quote: There is nothing I would not do for those who are really my friends. I have no notion of loving people by halves, it is not my nature.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Northanger Abbey

quotes.quote: If I had a flower for every time I thought of you...I could walk through my garden forever.
quotes.author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quotes.quote: We're born alone, we live alone, we die alone. Only through our love and friendship can we create the illusion for the moment that we're not alone.
quotes.author: Orson Welles

quotes.quote: When someone loves you, the way they talk about you is different. You feel safe and comfortable.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Intern

quotes.quote: There is nothing better than a friend, unless it is a friend with chocolate.
quotes.author: Linda Grayson

quotes.quote: Experts on romance say for a happy marriage there has to be more than a passionate love. For a lasting union, they insist, there must be a genuine liking for each other. Which, in my book, is a good definition for friendship.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: Never be afraid to meet to the hilt the demand of either work, or friendship - two of life's major assets.
quotes.author: Eleanor Robson Belmont

quotes.quote: Between men and women there is no friendship possible. There is passion, enmity, worship, love, but no friendship.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Friendship marks a life even more deeply than love. Love risks degenerating into obsession, friendship is never anything but sharing.
quotes.author: Elie Wiesel

quotes.quote: It is one of the blessings of old friends that you can afford to be stupid with them.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  Emerson in His Journals

quotes.quote: I would rather walk with a friend in the dark, than alone in the light.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: Life is an awful, ugly place to not have a best friend.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Someone Like You

quotes.quote: It's the friends you can call up at 4 a.m. that matter.
quotes.author: Marlene Dietrich

quotes.quote: Books are the quietest and most constant of friends; they are the most accessible and wisest of counselors, and the most patient of teachers.
quotes.author: Charles William Eliot

quotes.quote: Friendship is Love without his wings!
quotes.author: Lord Byron

quotes.quote: The greatest healing therapy is friendship and love.
quotes.author: Hubert H. Humphrey

quotes.quote: Love is the only force capable of transforming an enemy into friend.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.quote: Love is blind; friendship closes its eyes.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: You're going to come across people in your life who will say all the right words at all the right times. But in the end, it's always their actions you should judge them by. It's actions, not words, that matter.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Rescue

quotes.quote: I don't know half of you half as well as I should like; and I like less than half of you half as well as you deserve.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: You are my best friend as well as my lover, and I do not know which side of you I enjoy the most. I treasure each side, just as I have treasured our life together.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

quotes.quote: Promise me you'll always remember: You're braver than you believe, and stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: When you're in jail, a good friend will be trying to bail you out. A best friend will be in the cell next to you saying, 'Damn, that was fun'.
quotes.author: Groucho Marx

quotes.quote: The real test of friendship is: can you literally do nothing with the other person? Can you enjoy those moments of life that are utterly simple?
quotes.author: Eugene Kennedy

quotes.quote: I would be willing to do almost anything to make Art happy. I care about our friendship. The only thing I won't do is change the essence of my work.
quotes.author: Paul Simon

quotes.quote: Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art.... It has no survival value; rather it is one of those things which give value to survival.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Four Loves

quotes.quote: Friendship is the shadow of the evening, which increases with the setting sun of life.
quotes.author: Jean de La Fontaine

quotes.quote: In everyone's life, at some time, our inner fire goes out. It is then burst into flame by an encounter with another human being. We should all be thankful for those people who rekindle the inner spirit.
quotes.author: Albert Schweitzer

quotes.quote: I've always wanted to be a mom because I want to give a kid all of the magical gifts my mom gave to me, such as love and friendship. She and I had this incredible connection that was so unbelievable.
quotes.author: Jennifer Love Hewitt

quotes.quote: I do not want people to be very agreeable, as it saves me the trouble of liking them a great deal.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Jane Austen's Letters

quotes.quote: You can't stay in your corner of the Forest waiting for others to come to you. You have to go to them sometimes.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne,  Winnie-the-Pooh

quotes.quote: A guy and a girl can be just friends, but at one point or another, they will fall for each other...Maybe temporarily, maybe at the wrong time, maybe too late, or maybe forever
quotes.author: Dave Matthews Band

quotes.quote: Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art... It has no survival value; rather it is one of those things that give value to survival.
quotes.author: C. S. Lewis

quotes.quote: The beginning of a friendship, the fact that two people out of the thousands around them can meet and connect and become friends, seems like a kind of magic to me. But maintaining a friendship requires work. I don't mean that as a bad thing. Good art requires work as well.
quotes.author: Charles de Lint

quotes.quote: Why did you do all this for me?' he asked. 'I don't deserve it. I've never done anything for you.' 'You have been my friend,' replied Charlotte. 'That in itself is a tremendous thing.
quotes.author: E.B. White,  Charlotte's Web

quotes.quote: What is a friend? A single soul dwelling in two bodies.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing there is a field.I'll meet you there.When the soul lies down in that grassthe world is too full to talk about.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: Sometimes being a friend means mastering the art of timing. There is a time for silence. A time to let go and allow people to hurl themselves into their own destiny. And a time to prepare to pick up the pieces when it's all over.
quotes.author: Octavia Butler

quotes.quote: I think if I've learned anything about friendship, it's to hang in, stay connected, fight for them, and let them fight for you. Don't walk away, don't be distracted, don't be too busy or tired, don't take them for granted. Friends are part of the glue that holds life and faith together. Powerful stuff.
quotes.author: Jon Katz

quotes.quote: What sweetness is left in life, if you take away friendship? Robbing life of friendship is like robbing the world of the sun. A true friend is more to be esteemed than kinsfolk.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: If we are to judge of love by its consequences, it more nearly resembles hatred than friendship.
quotes.author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: Love and esteem are the first principles of friendship; it is always imperfect if either of these two are wanting.
quotes.author: Eustace Budgell

quotes.quote: The best time to frame an answer to the letters of a friend, is the moment you receive them. Then the warmth of friendship, and the intelligence received, most forcibly cooperate.
quotes.author: William Shenstone

quotes.quote: Very different from eros is philia, a serene love much more akin to friendship, with its reciprocal kindnesses. You love each other for the happy experiences and pleasures you share.
quotes.author: Francois Lelord

quotes.quote: There are a lot of musicians I've met on Twitter where it was like, 'Hey, I like your music' - and then I ended up meeting them and it turned into a friendship.
quotes.author: Grimes

quotes.quote: It is impossible to preserve my friendship with people who are allegedly leaders when they are attacking their own people, shooting at them, using tanks and other forms of heavy weaponry.
quotes.author: Recep Tayyip Erdogan

quotes.quote: I'm friends with Taylor Swift, and I am tired of people asking me questions about our friendship. When I post a picture of us on Instagram, I'm posting a picture of me and my friend.
quotes.author: Sarah Hyland

quotes.quote: I've known my best friend since I was a baby, and I don't know what I would do without her. She is always straight with me and can make me laugh hysterically. Everyone should have someone like that in their life.
quotes.author: Jasmine Guinness

quotes.quote: When I was working on my first novel, 'The Quilter's Apprentice,' I knew I wanted to write about friendship, especially women's friendship and how women use friendship to sustain themselves and nurture each other.
quotes.author: Jennifer Chiaverini

quotes.quote: I would have told him that I appreciated his friendship through the years and that I had learned a lot from him. I really loved Frank like you do a brother.
quotes.author: Jimmy Carl Black

quotes.quote: We want 'Doll & Em' to be something we're proud of. We'd love to do another series, but it's not the be-all and end-all. Our friendship is the be-all and end-all.
quotes.author: Dolly Wells

quotes.quote: Friendship often ends in love; but love in friendship - never.
quotes.author: Charles Caleb Colton

quotes.quote: On the relationship side, if you teach people to respond actively and constructively when someone they care about has a victory, it increases love and friendship and decreases the probability of depression.
quotes.author: Martin Seligman

quotes.quote: I usually give a book 40 pages. If it doesn't grab me by then, adios. With young adult books, you can usually tell by Page 4 if it's worth the time. The author establishes the conflict early, sometimes in the first sentence. The themes of hope, family, friendship and overcoming hardship appeal to most everyone.
quotes.author: Regina Brett

quotes.quote: One look at an email can rob you of 15 minutes of focus. One call on your cell phone, one tweet, one instant message can destroy your schedule, forcing you to move meetings, or blow off really important things, like love, and friendship.
quotes.author: Jacqueline Leo

quotes.quote: It may happen sometimes that a long debate becomes the cause of a longer friendship. Commonly, those who dispute with one another at last agree.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: Be true to yourself. Make each day a masterpiece. Help others. Drink deeply from good books. Make friendship a fine art. Build a shelter against a rainy day.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: The strong bond of friendship is not always a balanced equation; friendship is not always about giving and taking in equal shares. Instead, friendship is grounded in a feeling that you know exactly who will be there for you when you need something, no matter what or when.
quotes.author: Simon Sinek

quotes.quote: Meg Ryan is a beautiful and courageous woman. I grieve the loss of her companionship but I've not lost the friendship. We talk all the time and that was what our connection was about. She has a wonderful mind and we just like a chat.
quotes.author: Russell Crowe

quotes.quote: Moral science is better occupied when treating of friendship than of justice.
quotes.author: Thomas Aquinas

quotes.quote: The lust and attraction are often a given in a romance novel - I want to dig into the elements of true friendship that form a foundation for a solid, gonna-last-forever romantic relationship.
quotes.author: Suzanne Brockmann

quotes.quote: If we listened to our intellect, we'd never have a love affair. We'd never have a friendship. We'd never go into business, because we'd be cynical. Well, that's nonsense. You've got to jump off cliffs all the time and build your wings on the way down.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: Some people are willing to betray years of friendship just to get a little bit of the spotlight.
quotes.author: Lauren Conrad

quotes.quote: The fact is, with every friendship you make, and every bond of trust you establish, you are shaping the image of America projected to the rest of the world. That is so important. So when you study abroad, you're actually helping to make America stronger.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: Friendship may, and often does, grow into love, but love never subsides into friendship.
quotes.author: Lord Byron

quotes.quote: True friendship ought never to conceal what it thinks.
quotes.author: St. Jerome

quotes.quote: A youth, when at home, should be filial and, abroad, respectful to his elders. He should be earnest and truthful. He should overflow in love to all and cultivate the friendship of the good. When he has time and opportunity, after the performance of these things, he should employ them in polite studies.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: For prayer is nothing else than being on terms of friendship with God.
quotes.author: Saint Teresa of Avila

quotes.quote: I really wasn't even aware that Batman and Superman had this kind of grudging friendship.
quotes.author: Mark Valley

quotes.quote: Happiness is understanding that friendship is more precious than mere things, more precious than getting your own way, more precious than being in situations where true principles are not at stake.
quotes.author: J. Donald Walters

quotes.quote: Show me a genuine case of platonic friendship, and I shall show you two old or homely faces.
quotes.author: Austin O'Malley

quotes.quote: A good painting to me has always been like a friend. It keeps me company, comforts and inspires.
quotes.author: Hedy Lamarr

quotes.quote: 'Shake It Up' definitely teaches kids about the importance of reaching for your dreams and setting high goals. It also teaches great lessons about friendship and family.
quotes.author: Zendaya

quotes.quote: I have long enjoyed the friendship and companionship of Republicans because I am by instinct a teacher, and I would like to teach them something.
quotes.author: Woodrow Wilson

quotes.quote: I had a friend where it turned out that she hated my guts, all through our friendship. I thought she was my best friend, and then, in high school, she turned on me and had sordid affairs with all of the people that I'd dated. It was less hurtful because I was in high school, so it was more like, 'What's wrong with you? Gross!'
quotes.author: Mae Whitman

quotes.quote: Love is the attempt to form a friendship inspired by beauty.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: I understand by this passion the union of desire, friendship, and tenderness, which is inflamed by a single female, which prefers her to the rest of her sex, and which seeks her possession as the supreme or the sole happiness of our being.
quotes.author: Edward Gibbon

quotes.quote: Neatness begets order; but from order to taste there is the same difference as from taste to genius, or from love to friendship.
quotes.author: Johann Kaspar Lavater

quotes.quote: Sweat makes good friendship cement.
quotes.author: Tyne Daly

quotes.quote: The second one, the joint Truth and Friendship Commission, which we started now with Indonesia, that is the one that has been criticized; its terms of reference call for providing amnesty for those who cooperate in telling the truth. It does not lead to prosecution.
quotes.author: Jose Ramos-Horta

quotes.quote: I loved my 17 years with R.E.M., but I'm ready to reflect, assess and move on to a different phase of my life. The four of us will continue our close friendship, and I look forward to hearing their future efforts as the world's biggest R.E.M. fan.
quotes.author: Bill Berry

quotes.quote: That was the day I began cutting classes and returning to TV tapings; it ultimately led to a friendship with Johnny O, and an increasing fascination and respect for what he did.
quotes.author: Randy West

quotes.quote: In those early years in New York when I was a stranger in a big city, it was the companionship and later friendship which I was offered in the Linnean Society that was the most important thing in my life.
quotes.author: Ernst Mayr

quotes.quote: India-Seychelles relations have been characterized by close friendship, understanding and cooperation.
quotes.author: Pratibha Patil

quotes.quote: I have a loyalty that runs in my bloodstream, when I lock into someone or something, you can't get me away from it because I commit that thoroughly. That's in friendship, that's a deal, that's a commitment. Don't give me paper - I can get the same lawyer who drew it up to break it. But if you shake my hand, that's for life.
quotes.author: Jerry Lewis

quotes.quote: I don't know if I've ever been in a clique. The older I've gotten, the more I've realized what a true friend really is. So my friendship circle has changed a bit.
quotes.author: Aimee Teegarden

quotes.quote: A gang is the same as a wolf pack; gang members do not use their energies in friendship with one another, for they do not know what friendship is. If they are united, it is by the common bond of a desire to attack their world.
quotes.author: Haniel Long

quotes.quote: Depth of friendship does not depend on length of acquaintance.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.quote: Friendship is the complete explanation of what a Cheetah Girl is - if you have that true friendship, you can conquer anything you want.
quotes.author: Sabrina Bryan

quotes.quote: Love is a friendship set to music.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell

quotes.quote: The essence of true friendship is to make allowance for another's little lapses.
quotes.author: David Storey

quotes.quote: One's life has value so long as one attributes value to the life of others, by means of love, friendship, indignation and compassion.
quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir

quotes.quote: Fan the sinking flame of hilarity with the wing of friendship; and pass the rosy wine.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens

quotes.quote: Rock n' roll as a genre is different from pop and hip hop: it is about bands, and that for me suggests brotherhood, family, friendship and community.
quotes.author: Steven Van Zandt

quotes.quote: Friendships are the family we make - not the one we inherit. I've always been someone to whom friendship, elective affinities, is as important as family.
quotes.author: Salman Rushdie

quotes.quote: Our philosophy precedes from the belief that sport is an inalienable part of the educational process and a factor for promoting peace, friendship, cooperation and understanding among peoples.
quotes.author: Juan Antonio Samaranch

quotes.quote: I feel friendship towards philosophers, but towards sophists, teachers of literature, or any other such kind of godforsaken people, I neither feel friendship now, nor may I ever do so in the future.
quotes.author: Apollonius of Tyana

quotes.quote: I don't need to go onto Facebook and pretend to have friends I've never even met. To my mind, that kind of destroys the meaning of the word 'friend.' I take exception to that. Because I value and respect friendship.
quotes.author: Stefanie Powers

quotes.quote: When I turned about 14, I developed a friendship with this guy whose mom was the secretary to Ernest Angley, the faith healer, who's very popular in the Midwest. He had a television show, and he was sort of like Liberace mixed with Jerry Falwell - very glitzy, very high-tech.
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: Friendship is the hardest thing in the world to explain. It's not something you learn in school. But if you haven't learned the meaning of friendship, you really haven't learned anything.
quotes.author: Muhammad Ali

quotes.quote: Even where friendship is concerned, it takes me a long time to trust people.
quotes.author: Namie Amuro

quotes.quote: They took their meals together; and it was remarked on such occasions, when the friendship of animals is put to a hard test, that they never quarrelled or disputed the possession of a favourite fruit with each other.
quotes.author: Henry Walter Bates

quotes.quote: I was desperate for a friend, and I used to lie in bed at night thinking about what it would be like. My younger brothers and sisters had friends, and I used to watch them playing to try to work out what they did and how friendship worked.
quotes.author: Daniel Tammet

quotes.quote: Ray Bradbury is, for many reasons, the most influential writer in my life. Throughout our long friendship, Ray supplied not only his terrific stories but a grand model of what a writer could be, should be, and yet rarely is: brilliant and charming and accessible, willing to tolerate and to teach, happy to inspire but also to be inspired.
quotes.author: Greg Bear

quotes.quote: But as I was saying, from my experiences, I think men tend to be more timid in expressing their feelings for you. Regardless, I always prefer a friendship first and foremost.
quotes.author: Alicia Machado

quotes.quote: French Yemeni relations are strong and good, they are relations depending on friendship and cooperation; my relationship with the president Chiraq are old and real.
quotes.author: Ali Abdullah Saleh

quotes.quote: I suppose, the natural outgrowth about writing about two friends, it becomes about their friendship, and the complexities of it, and the way personality plays off each other, and what they each like to do, separately and together.
quotes.author: Alison McGhee

quotes.quote: Throughout its history, the international Olympic Committee has struggled to spread its ideal of fraternity, friendship, peace and universal understanding.
quotes.author: Juan Antonio Samaranch

quotes.quote: Keep your sense of humor, my friend; if you don't have a sense of humor it just isn't funny anymore.
quotes.author: Wavy Gravy

quotes.quote: 006 was such an interesting character and the film really explored his friendship with Bond and how it all went wrong, so it was a very personal journey for both characters.
quotes.author: Sean Bean

quotes.quote: How many slams in an old screen door? Depends how loud you shut it. How many slices in a bread? Depends how thin you cut it. How much good inside a day? Depends how good you live 'em. How much love inside a friend? Depends how much you give 'em.
quotes.author: Shel Silverstein

quotes.quote: I do think, in time, people will have, sort of, relationships with certain kinds of robots - not every robot, but certain kinds of robots - where they might feel that it is a sort of friendship, but it's going to be of a robot-human kind.
quotes.author: Cynthia Breazeal

quotes.quote: The friendship of Shostakovich cast a brilliant light over my whole life and whose spiritual qualities captured my soul once and for all time.
quotes.author: Galina Vishnevskaya

quotes.quote: I gave Mitt Romney some donations for his campaign because he was a friend, and friendship came first. I've always been a Democrat, and I've had different views than Mitt Romney. I'm not Mitt Romney, and I think people will realize that when they meet me out there.
quotes.author: Stephen Pagliuca

quotes.quote: Today, I, too, wish to reaffirm that I intend to continue on the path toward improved relations and friendship with the Jewish people, following the decisive lead given by John Paul II.
quotes.author: Pope Benedict XVI

quotes.quote: And though my Lord hath lost his estate and been banished out of his country, yet neither despised poverty nor pinching necessity could make him break the bonds of friendship or weaken his loyal duty.
quotes.author: Margaret Cavendish

quotes.quote: The rules of friendship are tacit, unconscious; they are not rational. In business, though, you have to think rationally.
quotes.author: Steven Pinker

quotes.quote: Only a true best friend can protect you from your immortal enemies.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Vampire Academy

quotes.quote: What I particularly like about Broadway is the camaraderie and the friendship of other people in other shows. Everybody knows you're opening and cares about you. There's a real village atmosphere.
quotes.author: Ian Mckellen

quotes.quote: Around the time I graduated from high school, I decided better to underachieve and have friendship than to overachieve and be alone.
quotes.author: Evangeline Lilly

quotes.quote: Allowing a friend to careen toward self destruction is not friendship. That is a habit the United States needs to break as it pursues a richer and more deeply supportive relationship with Israel.
quotes.author: Stephen Kinzer

quotes.quote: Prosecutors say it would be next to impossible to get one teen to testify in court that another had slipped him or her a copied disc at lunchtime. And besides, isn't sharing music a time-honored part of teen friendship?
quotes.author: Charles Duhigg

quotes.quote: I got to sing with Placido Domingo... I got to sing with Aaron Neville, who is one of my favorites. Got to sing with Brian Wilson, one of the great high tenors. And Ricky Skaggs, a bluegrass tenor. I'm also proud of my musical friendship with Emmylou Harris.
quotes.author: Linda Ronstadt

quotes.quote: Bad faith likes discourse on friendship and loyalty.
quotes.author: Mason Cooley

quotes.quote: I want to know what it is to build the foundation of the friendship for real, to have my best friend and not because we're just intimate, but because we're mentally intimate. So I'm waiting for that person to come into my life.
quotes.author: LisaRaye McCoy-Misick

quotes.quote: I only understand friendship or scorched earth.
quotes.author: Roger Ailes

quotes.quote: When the world is so complicated, the simple gift of friendship is within all of our hands.
quotes.author: Maria Shriver

quotes.quote: Friendship's the wine of life: but friendship new... is neither strong nor pure.
quotes.author: Edward Young

quotes.quote: The sacrifices of friendship were beautiful in her eyes as long as she was not asked to make them.
quotes.author: Hector Hugh Munro

quotes.quote: I'm loyal, and I like my friends. Friendship enriches your life and makes it more interesting.
quotes.author: Wendi Deng Murdoch

quotes.quote: I think the way to keep a friendship is to respect that everybody is different.
quotes.author: Emma Bunton

quotes.quote: You know, real life doesn't just suddenly resolve itself. You have to keep working at it. Democracy, marriage, friendship. You can't just say, 'She's my best friend.' That's not a given, it's a process.
quotes.author: Viggo Mortensen

quotes.quote: He must have known I'd want to leave you.""No, he must have known you would always want to come back.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.quote: All those who offer an opinion on any doubtful point should first clear their minds of every sentiment of dislike, friendship, anger or pity.
quotes.author: Sallust

quotes.quote: No person is your friend who demands your silence, or denies your right to grow.
quotes.author: Alice Walker

quotes.quote: Well, it seems to me that the best relationships - the ones that last - are frequently the ones that are rooted in friendship. You know, one day you look at the person and you see something more than you did the night before. Like a switch has been flicked somewhere. And the person who was just a friend is... suddenly the only person you can ever imagine yourself with.
quotes.author: Gillian Anderson

quotes.quote: It is more fun to talk with someone who doesn't use long, difficult words but rather short, easy words like "What about lunch?
quotes.author: A.A. Milne,  Winnie-the-Pooh

quotes.quote: My second husband believed I had such a fickle attitude to friendship that each Friday he would update the list of my 'Top Ten' friends in the manner of a Top Of The Pops chart countdown.
quotes.author: Julie Burchill

quotes.quote: The Bush Administration's failure to be consistently involved in helping Israel achieve peace with the Palestinians has been both wrong for our friendship with Israel, as well as badly damaging to our standing in the Arab world.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: The steady discipline of intimate friendship with Jesus results in men becoming like Him.
quotes.author: Harry Emerson Fosdick

quotes.quote: A lot of the powerful religious leaders, from Jesus to Buddha to Tibetan monks, they're really talking about the same things: love and acceptable, and the value of friendship, and respecting yourself so you can respect others.
quotes.author: Jena Malone

quotes.quote: I think romance is friendship and attraction sort of meeting together and that does influence what I'm writing a lot. I try to establish the attraction, obviously, but I also think it's important to show the characters having actual conversations about things other than their feelings for each other - and to develop their friendship on the page.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth

quotes.quote: In romance, we feel the need to zoom in and expound on our partner's foibles in intimate detail; in friendship, we tend to do the opposite, avoiding confrontation through fear, lethargy or both.
quotes.author: Mariella Frostrup

quotes.quote: Friendship, like credit, is highest when it is not used.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: There is a scarcity of friendship, but not of friends.
quotes.author: Thomas Fuller

quotes.quote: I've learned from my dealings with Johnny Carson that no matter what kind of friendship you think you have with people you're working with, when the chips are down, it's all about business.
quotes.author: Joan Rivers

quotes.quote: Friendship increases in visiting friends, but in visiting them seldom.
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.quote: There are no rules for friendship. It must be left to itself. We cannot force it any more than love.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: Friendship always benefits; love sometimes injures.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Each friend represents a world in us, a world possibly not born until they arrive, and it is only by this meeting that a new world is born.
quotes.author: AnaÃ¯s Nin,  The Diary of AnaÃ¯s Nin, Vol. 1: 1931-1934

quotes.quote: Value your friendship. Value your relationships.
quotes.author: Barbara Bush

quotes.quote: The dupe of friendship, and the fool of love; have I not reason to hate and to despise myself? Indeed I do; and chiefly for not having hated and despised the world enough.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: There is no surer foundation for a beautiful friendship than a mutual taste in literature.
quotes.author: P.G. Wodehouse

quotes.quote: Sixth grade was a big time, in my childhood, of hoops and friendship, and coming up with funny things.
quotes.author: Adam Sandler

quotes.quote: It is wise to apply the oil of refined politeness to the mechanism of friendship.
quotes.author: Sidonie Gabrielle Colette

quotes.quote: Don't flatter yourselves that friendship authorizes you to say disagreeable things to your intimates. On the contrary, the nearer you come into relation with a person, the more necessary do tact and courtesy become.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Sr.

quotes.quote: I hope to continue my friendship with France and its filmmakers for many years to come.
quotes.author: Harvey Weinstein

quotes.quote: One of the surest evidences of friendship that one individual can display to another is telling him gently of a fault. If any other can excel it, it is listening to such a disclosure with gratitude, and amending the error.
quotes.author: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

quotes.quote: There is no friendship, no love, like that of the parent for the child.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: The bracelet says 'Fear Nothing.' It was given to me by my friends, and it was made for me and my friends during the period of time that I was going through chemotherapy. And I still wear it, because it's a great reminder of friendship and how my buddies and others came together in my time of need.
quotes.author: Joseph J. Lhota

quotes.quote: Music is the social act of communication among people, a gesture of friendship, the strongest there is.
quotes.author: Malcolm Arnold

quotes.quote: Marriage is the highest state of friendship. If happy, it lessens our cares by dividing them, at the same time that it doubles our pleasures by mutual participation.
quotes.author: Samuel Richardson

quotes.quote: Real friendship, like real poetry, is extremely rare - and precious as a pearl.
quotes.author: Tahar Ben Jelloun

quotes.quote: Many a friendship, long, loyal, and self-sacrificing, rested at first on no thicker a foundation than a kind word.
quotes.author: Frederick William Faber

quotes.quote: Nobody likes being alone that much. I don't go out of my way to make friends, that's all. It just leads to disappointment.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

quotes.quote: I cherish the memory of being a friend of Frank Sinatra on a friendship level to the point where we really hung out. We worked in Vegas, we'd talk on the phone, and if I wasn't doing anything, I'd fly out, and I spent time in Palm Springs at his house - on a level the way friends would be, not with a whole crowd of people.
quotes.author: Frankie Valli

quotes.quote: To cement a new friendship, especially between foreigners or persons of a different social world, a spark with which both were secretly charged must fly from person to person, and cut across the accidents of place and time.
quotes.author: Cornelia Otis Skinner

quotes.quote: When friendship disappears then there is a space left open to that awful loneliness of the outside world which is like the cold space between the planets. It is an air in which men perish utterly.
quotes.author: Hilaire Belloc

quotes.quote: The feeling of friendship is like that of being comfortably filled with roast beef; love, like being enlivened with champagne.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: Friendship without self-interest is one of the rare and beautiful things of life.
quotes.author: James F. Byrnes

quotes.quote: I think friendship is more important than love, but that love that grows out of friendship is the very best of all.
quotes.author: Jane Green

quotes.quote: Do I not destroy my enemies when I make them my friends?
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Plunderous is the palate I gift to you, openly I hug the universe of our friendship expanding its outer limit.
quotes.author: Bradley Chicho

quotes.quote: Dad needs to show an incredible amount of respect and humor and friendship toward his mate so the kids understand their parents are sexy, they're fun, they do things together, they're best friends. Kids learn by example. If I respect Mom, they're going to respect Mom.
quotes.author: Tim Allen

quotes.quote: What drew me towards team sport were the camaraderie and friendship. The chance to celebrate victory and success with a group of other people is something I have enjoyed doing.
quotes.author: Rahul Dravid

quotes.quote: Eros will have naked bodies; Friendship naked personalities.
quotes.author: C. S. Lewis

quotes.quote: As far as an actor-director connection, I think those can develop, and when they do, they're really great, and you just cultivate it like you would any relationship or friendship. If you find that something special, it helps down the line when you want to do more projects with each other.
quotes.author: Taylor Handley

quotes.quote: Sometimes people walk into plays by accident - they don't even know what they're looking at; they just think to give it a chance. That can be the beginning of a long friendship.
quotes.author: Dylan Baker

quotes.quote: I'm single, footloose and fancy free, I have no responsibilities, no anchors. Work, friendship and self-improvement, that's me.
quotes.author: Joel Edgerton

quotes.quote: There are no faster or firmer friendships than those formed between people who love the same books.
quotes.author: Irving Stone,  Clarence Darrow for the Defense

quotes.quote: Do not keep on with a mockery of friendship after the substance is gone - but part, while you can part friends. Bury the carcass of friendship: it is not worth embalming.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: Madam, I have been looking for a person who disliked gravy all my life; let us swear eternal friendship.
quotes.author: Sydney Smith

quotes.quote: Why is it,"he said, one time, at the subway entrance, "I feel I've known you so many years?""Because I like you,"she said, "and I don't want anything from you.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: Stop using the word 'bromance.' Can we please kill that stupid term? We're just friends. It's called friendship!
quotes.author: Blake Shelton

quotes.quote: There was really no friendship in modeling, though a certain amount of warmth comes from running into models you know on shoots, because you end up in so many unfamiliar places, from Alaska to Africa.
quotes.author: Carol Alt

quotes.quote: If a man does not make new acquaintances as he advances through life, he will soon find himself left alone. A man, sir, should keep his friendship in a constant repair.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: One friend in a lifetime is much; two are many; three are hardly possible. Friendship needs a certain parallelism of life, a community of thought, a rivalry of aim.
quotes.author: Brooks Adams

quotes.quote: The knot of intimacy at the center of 'Ten Thousand Saints' is the friendship between Teddy McNicholas and Jude Keffy-Horn.
quotes.author: Stacey D'Erasmo

quotes.quote: It's quite difficult to write about female friendship without it seeming to be a very niche subject. It's a difficult balance.
quotes.author: Samantha Harvey

quotes.quote: I have a friendship with Hezbollah, and I also have contacts outside of Lebanon, but it doesn't mean I follow anyone's agenda.
quotes.author: Najib Mikati

quotes.quote: My book 'Ali Pasha' tells the true story of a young sailor Henry Friston, who, in the hell-fire of battle, forms an unusual friendship.
quotes.author: Michael Foreman

quotes.quote: If I'm right, the only reason our species is still around is because of our friendship with the canines.
quotes.author: Bruce Cameron

quotes.quote: When you say a friend has a sense of humor do you mean that he makes you laugh, or that he can make you laugh?
quotes.author: Max Frisch

quotes.quote: The rare few, who, early in life have rid themselves of the friendship of the many.
quotes.author: James Whistler

quotes.quote: The most deadly fruit is borne by the hatred which one grafts on an extinguished friendship.
quotes.author: Gotthold Ephraim Lessing

quotes.quote: If you have two friends in your lifetime, you're lucky. If you have one good friend, you're more than lucky.
quotes.author: S.E. Hinton

quotes.quote: A lot of women, when they're young, feel they have very good friends, and find later on that friendship is complicated. It's easy to be friends when everyone's 18.
quotes.author: Zadie Smith

quotes.quote: I don't think men are that attracted by glamour. I think women are attracted by glamour. I think men are attracted by a sense of friendship.
quotes.author: Joanna Lumley

quotes.quote: A band is a good way to break up a friendship.
quotes.author: Julian Casablancas

quotes.quote: I definitely have guys that I'm friends with that I have a crush on, and you don't want to ruin the friendship.
quotes.author: Miranda Cosgrove

quotes.quote: I've got many close friends, but there's an awful lot about friendship that is not demonstrative in my case.
quotes.author: Warren Christopher

quotes.quote: For me, 'Lamb' started out as a further exploration of the phenomenon of faith and the responsibility of a messiah that I touched on in 'Coyote Blue' and 'Island of the Sequined Love Nun,' but it ended up being an exploration of the true meaning of sacrifice, loyalty, and friendship.
quotes.author: Christopher Moore

quotes.quote: Since the Korean War, U.S. and South Korea have established an enduring friendship with shared interests, such as denuclearizing the Korean Peninsula, combating aggression abroad and developing our economies.
quotes.author: Charles B. Rangel

quotes.quote: Words are easy, like the wind; Faithful friends are hard to find.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  The Passionate Pilgrim

quotes.quote: Friendship is something that is cultivated.
quotes.author: Thalia

quotes.quote: Friendship is inexplicable, it should not be explained if one doesn't want to kill it.
quotes.author: Max Jacob

quotes.quote: I think quite a lot of people have a friendship or a love that's gone like that and it never quite reconciles properly.
quotes.author: Tim Finn

quotes.quote: I had more friends on my hockey team than I did on my soccer team. I might have been better at soccer, to be honest. But I think it was more the friendship, and my family was more of a hockey family than a soccer family, so when I had to make a decision, I tried hockey, and it turned out to be a good decision.
quotes.author: Carl Hagelin

quotes.quote: Any friendship or relationship is about a language.
quotes.author: Gina Bellman

quotes.quote: I went to boarding school in the country, so there's no real differentiation between family and friends. I went there from when I was 8 until I was 17 - it was insane. If you earn my friendship, you are my family, and I'll do anything for you.
quotes.author: Jamie Campbell Bower

quotes.quote: The most important thing for me is to have real friendship between Egyptians and Americans.
quotes.author: Mohammed Morsi

quotes.quote: There has to be chemistry in a duet, but if you go beyond the point of friendship and attraction, you lose something.
quotes.author: Kenny Rogers

quotes.quote: I play- it's kind of like a slice-of-life, LA women in their forties, playing forty kind of what's their friendship like, and what's their life like and so I just play one of the four friends.
quotes.author: Joan Cusack

quotes.quote: I am aloof by nature. I mind my own business. I'm good with everyone, and I get along fine with people. But work is work, and friendship is friendship. I never mix the two.
quotes.author: Sonakshi Sinha

quotes.quote: Growing apart doesn't change the fact that for a long time we grew side by side; our roots will always be tangled. I'm glad for that.
quotes.author: Ally Condie,  Matched

quotes.quote: Things have gone beyond my wildest expectations and dreams, and I feel like I've been given so many blessings in my life, between my friendship with the guys in the band, our wonderful audience, being able to play this music, and then my family.
quotes.author: Trey Anastasio

quotes.quote: Because most people are not sufficiently employed in themselves, they run about loose, hungering for employment, and satisfy themselves in various supererogatory occupations. The easiest of these occupations, which have all to do with making things already made, is the making of people: it is called the art of friendship.
quotes.author: Laura Riding

quotes.quote: I come from the New York theatre world, and I have a lot of gay male friends, so this friendship of Will and Grace's isn't such a stretch.
quotes.author: Debra Messing

quotes.quote: Blunders, no, only friendship binds us to honesty - attracting crypts of mushrooms in the wake of our snowboards.
quotes.author: Bradley Chicho

quotes.quote: You are almost not free, if you are teaching a group of graduate students, to become friends with one of them. I don't mean anything erotically charged, just a friendship.
quotes.author: Marilyn Hacker

quotes.quote: In closing I wish to say that while I was sorely beset by a number of white riders in my racing days, I have also enjoyed the friendship of countless thousands of white men whom I class as among my closest friends.
quotes.author: Major Taylor

quotes.quote: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies but also to hate his friends.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Some birds are not meant to be caged, that's all. Their feathers are too bright, their songs too sweet and wild. So you let them go, or when you open the cage to feed them they somehow fly out past you. And the part of you that knows it was wrong to imprison them in the first place rejoices, but still, the place where you live is that much more drab and empty for their departure.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption: A Story from Different Seasons

quotes.quote: Silence make the real conversations between friends. Not the saying, but the never needing to say that counts.
quotes.author: Margaret Lee Runbeck

quotes.quote: The friendship that can cease has never been real.
quotes.author: St. Jerome

quotes.quote: I love life in spite of all that mars it. I love friendship, jokes and laughter.
quotes.author: Tahar Ben Jelloun

quotes.quote: Our scientific age demands that we provide definitions, measurements, and statistics in order to be taken seriously. Yet most of the important things in life cannot be precisely defined or measured. Can we define or measure love, beauty, friendship, or decency, for example?
quotes.author: Dennis Prager

quotes.quote: Sustaining true friendship is a lot more challenging than we give it credit for.
quotes.author: Mariella Frostrup

quotes.quote: I think what 'The Hobbit' and Middle-earth deal in are quite universal and timeless themes of honour and love and friendship... so they're things that do resonate with people.
quotes.author: Martin Freeman

quotes.quote: My parents, and librarians along the way, taught me about the space between words; about the margins, where so many juicy moments of life and spirit and friendship could be found. In a library, you could find miracles and truth and you might find something that would make you laugh so hard that you get shushed, in the friendliest way.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: Sincere friendship towards God, in all who believe him to be properly an intelligent, willing being, does most apparently, directly, and strongly incline to prayer; and it no less disposes the heart strongly to desire to have our infinitely glorious.
quotes.author: Jonathan Edwards

quotes.quote: Share your smile with the world. It's a symbol of friendship and peace.
quotes.author: Christie Brinkley

quotes.quote: My last public performance for money was in 1967. For free, it was 1972, with the exception of two little one-shot, one-song things. But that's just for friends, out of friendship for the people involved, and also because it was fun.
quotes.author: Tom Lehrer

quotes.quote: As is natural with contiguous states having like institutions and like aims of advancement and development, the friendship of the United States and Mexico has been constantly maintained.
quotes.author: Chester A. Arthur

quotes.quote: We became friends as we became a band. Our friendship evolved as the band evolved. It had its ups and downs, but it was mostly ups for the four of us. We got along well almost all of the time. Hey! We liked each other and we still do.
quotes.author: Dave Blood

quotes.quote: A friendship that like love is warm; A love like friendship, steady.
quotes.author: Thomas Moore

quotes.quote: All lasting business is built on friendship.
quotes.author: Alfred A. Montapert

quotes.quote: Perfect friendship is the friendship of men who are good, and alike in excellence; for these wish well alike to each other qua good, and they are good in themselves.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: However rare true love may be, it is less so than true friendship.
quotes.author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: If there is such a thing as a good marriage, it is because it resembles friendship rather than love.
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.quote: Opposition is true friendship.
quotes.author: William Blake

quotes.quote: What men have called friendship is only a social arrangement, a mutual adjustment of interests, an interchange of services given and received; it is, in sum, simply a business from which those involved propose to derive a steady profit for their own self-love.
quotes.author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: Friendship is a sheltering tree.
quotes.author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quotes.quote: Love is like the wild rose-briar; Friendship like the holly-tree. The holly is dark when the rose-briar blooms, but which will bloom most constantly?
quotes.author: Emily Bronte

quotes.quote: Peace and friendship with all mankind is our wisest policy, and I wish we may be permitted to pursue it.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: The worst part of success is trying to find someone who is happy for you.
quotes.author: Bette Midler

quotes.quote: Friendship often ends in love, but love in friendship - never.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Of all the things which wisdom provides to make us entirely happy, much the greatest is the possession of friendship.
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.quote: I define friendship as a bond that transcends all barriers. When you are ready to expect anything and everything from friends, good, bad or ugly... that's what I call true friendship.
quotes.author: Harbhajan Singh

quotes.quote: No distance of place or lapse of time can lessen the friendship of those who are thoroughly persuaded of each other's worth.
quotes.author: Robert Southey

quotes.quote: If one of two lovers is loyal, and the other jealous and false, how may their friendship last, for Love is slain!
quotes.author: Marie de France

quotes.quote: People come, people go - they'll drift in and out of your life, almost like characters in a favorite book. When you finally close the cover, the characters have told their story and you start up again with another book, complete with new characters and adventures. Then you find yourself focusing on the new ones, not the ones from the past.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Rescue

quotes.quote: The joys of friendship inert the heart and fizzy home bouncing jubilantly with laughter-buttered love.
quotes.author: Bradley Chicho

quotes.quote: No doubt, the most important thing in my career was my time with Mr. Bergman, with whom I worked in so many films and also in so many stage productions, so it was a continuous working relationship and also a friendship, of course, that lasted for so many years.
quotes.author: Max von Sydow

quotes.quote: The greatest gift of life is friendship, and I have received it.
quotes.author: Hubert H. Humphrey

quotes.quote: Tis the privilege of friendship to talk nonsense, and to have her nonsense respected.
quotes.author: Charles Lamb,  The Life, Letters and Writings of Charles Lamb

quotes.quote: My reputation is too important to put it aside for purposes of some friendship. We have a job to do.
quotes.author: Stephanie Tubbs Jones

quotes.quote: It's always really challenging trying to go from player to player/coach. You have a kind of friendship basis of relationship with all of your teammates, and now you go to this power position where you have to make decisions that might hurt people's feelings.
quotes.author: Abby Wambach

quotes.quote: Likings arise when one has no earthly reason for liking - the most wildly improbable marriages and uncommon friendship.
quotes.author: Patrick O'Brian

quotes.quote: There are some things you can't share without ending up liking each other, and knocking out a twelve-foot mountain troll is one of them.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

quotes.quote: I despise shows that present friendship where you're always there for each other and really strong because I don't know anyone like that. I mean, I've got great friends, but I can go months without seeing them because I think, 'I just can't deal with having to give you anything.'
quotes.author: Sharon Horgan

quotes.quote: I had already found that it was not good to be alone, and so made companionship with what there was around me, sometimes with the universe and sometimes with my own insignificant self; but my books were always my friends, let fail all else.
quotes.author: Joshua Slocum,  Sailing Alone around the World

quotes.quote: When it comes to Pakistan, the first word that comes to the mind of the Chinese is 'iron brother.' To us Chinese, Pakistan is always a trustworthy friend who is as solid as iron. Actually, Chinese netizens refer to Pakistan as 'Iron Pak.' This testifies to the strength of China-Pakistan friendship.
quotes.author: Li Keqiang

quotes.quote: The capacity for friendship is God's way of apologizing for our families.
quotes.author: Jay McInerney,  The Last of the Savages

quotes.quote: The ideal of all Kosovo is membership in the E.U. and a permanent friendship with the United States. I believe and I am convinced our dreams will come true.
quotes.author: Atifete Jahjaga

quotes.quote: But, based on my friendship with Evie as young mothers, I started going on freedom rides in 1966.
quotes.author: June Jordan

quotes.quote: One of the great things personally coming to Hawai'i is my friendship of Jim Nicholson.
quotes.author: Dan Fouts

quotes.quote: Animals are my friends...and I don't eat my friends.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: This airline is grateful for his extensive contributions and we will miss his friendship and support. We extend our deepest sympathies to the Casey family on its personal loss.
quotes.author: Gerard Arpey

quotes.quote: It became very clear to the director that it would be foolish not to use our friendship. I had tried to talk to him about it because all the relationships in the film are so, not negative, but antagonistic. There's not a lot of love going around.
quotes.author: Jennifer Beals

quotes.quote: I cannot even imagine where I would be today were it not for that handful of friends who have given me a heart full of joy. Let's face it, friends make life a lot more fun.
quotes.author: Charles R. Swindoll

quotes.quote: I think faith helps me a lot. God wants you to be where He wants you to be, and that's where I want to be. If I do not get a part, I understand that maybe I needed to be home at that time, maybe in school; there's always a reason. My faith is also where my core friends are, at my church, a faith-based friendship.
quotes.author: Jason Dolley

quotes.quote: A snowball in the face is surely the perfect beginning to a lasting friendship.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

quotes.quote: Richard Donner's friendship and guidance showed me that there's more to life than being an actor.
quotes.author: Jeff Cohen

quotes.quote: If you have good friends, no matter how much life is sucking , they can make you laugh.
quotes.author: P.C. Cast

quotes.quote: Here's a news flash: No soldier gives his life. That's not the way it works. Most soldiers who make a conscious decision to place themselves in harm's way do it to protect their buddies. They do it because of the bonds of friendship - and it goes so much deeper than friendship.
quotes.author: Eric Massa

quotes.quote: The glory of friendship is not the outstretched hand, not the kindly smile, nor the joy of companionship; it is the spiritual inspiration that comes to one when you discover that someone else believes in you and is willing to trust you with a friendship.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: When the bank asks me about my assets, I include my friendship with Regis Philbin.
quotes.author: Lou Holtz

quotes.quote: As told in Friendship with God, if we simply decided to believe and act as if first, we're all one, and second, life is eternal, it would render virtually everything we've done all our lives pointless.
quotes.author: Neale Donald Walsch

quotes.quote: I experience for the American officers and soldiers that friendship which arises from having shared with them for a length of time dangers, sufferings, and both good and evil fortune.
quotes.author: Marquis de Lafayette

quotes.quote: Never was a man further from a partiality for Spain than I am. But I think I now have left them in a sincere and steady intention to cultivate the friendship of America.
quotes.author: Marquis de Lafayette

quotes.quote: Friendship is one of our most treasured relationships, but it isn't codified and celebrated; it's never going to give you a party.
quotes.author: Hanya Yanagihara

quotes.quote: I find that the Amazon comments often are exceptionally shrewd and insightful, so I'm not going to diss them. But you don't really have any guarantees that what you're reading wasn't written out of friendship or spite.
quotes.author: Michael Dirda

quotes.quote: I firmly believe, only because I've been doing this for so long, every show takes three years. 90% of them don't get three years. It just does. It takes a long time to build a community, build a friendship with your characters. It's hard for people to grasp on and make them care about you.
quotes.author: Kaley Cuoco

quotes.quote: There was a time when I thought dudes had friendship all figured out. The focus on eating things in front of giant screens, pretending to punch one another, competing over who can utter the grossest and most profane personal insults imaginable - this struck me as the very apex of human social exchange.
quotes.author: Lynn Coady

quotes.quote: If Reagan had intelligence information that showed that the upheaval in Egypt is actually Democratic in spirit, then he would have, I believe, turned his back on Mubarak, even though there's a long friendship between the United States and Egypt.
quotes.author: Douglas Brinkley

quotes.quote: I don't like any kind of negativity. I try to be good to everyone, whether it's a love, a friend, an ex. I'll always try to treat people the way I want to be treated.
quotes.author: Nina Dobrev

quotes.quote: I think for a lot of people, friendship is a relationship that gets devalued once they move on to what people consider to be more important relationships: once you find a partner or when you have kids.
quotes.author: Hanya Yanagihara

quotes.quote: In a basic sense, 'A Little Life' is a homage to how my friends and I live our lives. I wanted to push past the definitions of how we typically define friendship. It's a different version of adulthood, but it's no less important and no less legitimate than anyone else's.
quotes.author: Hanya Yanagihara

quotes.quote: Yeah, I miss it. You don't just break off a friendship you've had with a sport, and with all those you've met all over the country. We've got some friends, some very close friends, and you just sit back and think how fortunate you were having a career like that. And, actually, there's nothing in the game of baseball that hasn't happened to me.
quotes.author: Lou Boudreau

quotes.quote: It gives me strength to have somebody to fight for; I can never fight for myself, but, for others, I can kill.
quotes.author: Emilie Autumn,  The Asylum for Wayward Victorian Girls

quotes.quote: I think people just like seeing friendship. I think people like seeing people who just drive each other up the wall, but at same time, can't live without each other.
quotes.author: Martin Freeman

quotes.quote: Working with people, the musical part is one thing but the personal part is totally different and just as critical. If the friendship is there and it's a lasting friendship, then it will take care of itself.
quotes.author: John Mayall

quotes.quote: Friendship- my definition- is built on two things. Respect and trust. Both elements have to be there. And it has to be mutual. You can have respect for someone, but if you don't have trust, the friendship will crumble.
quotes.author: Stieg Larsson,  The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo

quotes.quote: Love, friendship and respect do not unite people as much as a common hatred for something.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: We have to rise above bad fortune. We have to be in the good and enjoy the good, study and work and adventure and friendship and community and love.
quotes.author: Joshua Prager

quotes.quote: Loyalty and friendship, which is to me the same, created all the wealth that I've ever thought I'd have.
quotes.author: Ernie Banks

quotes.quote: You can't build anything with a flimsy foundation. Friendship is the foundation.
quotes.author: Hill Harper

quotes.quote: Rare as is true love, true friendship is rarer.
quotes.author: Jean de La Fontaine

quotes.quote: The only things that are really permanent are love, family, friendship, and that is a lesson. At the end of the day, that's really what it boils down to. The rest of it is just stuff.
quotes.author: Jared Kushner

quotes.quote: Watching John Lasseter's films, I think I can understand better than anyone that what he's doing, is going straight ahead with his vision and working really hard to get that vision into film form. And I feel that my understanding this of him is my friendship towards him.
quotes.author: Hayao Miyazaki

quotes.quote: One friend in a lifetime is much, two are many, three are hardly possible. Friendship needs a certain parallelism of life, a community of thought, a rivalry of aim.
quotes.author: Henry Adams

quotes.quote: Love is flower like; Friendship is like a sheltering tree.
quotes.author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quotes.quote: In the family, in interpersonal relationships, even in friendship, faith is tremendously important. If you have a partner who you believe is a good person, then it is your duty to have faith in them until the end, despite the fact that they might have done some bad things. And you have to support and believe in your children.
quotes.author: Greg Graffin

quotes.quote: Restoration of friendship with Russia, our biggest neighbor, is necessary for our peace and economy.
quotes.author: Bidzina Ivanishvili

quotes.quote: She discovered with great delight that one does not love one's children just because they are one's children but because of the friendship formed while raising them.
quotes.author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

quotes.quote: Many people will walk in and out of your life, but only true friends will leave footprints in your heart
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: Sympathy constitutes friendship; but in love there is a sort of antipathy, or opposing passion. Each strives to be the other, and both together make up one whole.
quotes.author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quotes.quote: There is no friendship in trade.
quotes.author: Cornelius Vanderbilt

quotes.quote: So far as it depends on the course of this government, our relations of good will and friendship will be sedulously cultivated with all nations.
quotes.author: John Tyler

quotes.quote: I am glad you are here with me. Here at the end of all things, Sam.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

quotes.quote: I am always saying "Glad to've met you"to somebody I'm not at all glad I met. If you want to stay alive, you have to say that stuff, though.
quotes.author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

quotes.quote: People instantly assume you can't have a platonic friendship with someone of the opposite sex. I think this may be specific to L.A. - or America.
quotes.author: Isabel Lucas

quotes.quote: To be capable of steady friendship or lasting love, are the two greatest proofs, not only of goodness of heart, but of strength of mind.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: If we would build on a sure foundation in friendship, we must love friends for their sake rather than for our own.
quotes.author: Charlotte Bronte

quotes.quote: Never leave a friend behind. Friends are all we have to get us through this life--and they are the only things from this world that we could hope to see in the next.
quotes.author: Dean Koontz,  Fear Nothing

quotes.quote: One hopes, of course, that a relationship grows and becomes a deep and wonderful marriage and friendship that lasts forever. But that's not always the case.
quotes.author: Alana Stewart

quotes.quote: The first two lessons, which we learned early in our efforts to be good member missionaries, have made sharing the Gospel much easier: We simply can't predict who will or won't be interested in the Gospel, and building a friendship is not a prerequisite to inviting people to learn about the Gospel.
quotes.author: Clayton Christensen

quotes.quote: Israelis can be proud of the vibrant democracy that they have created, and I know that many Rhode Islanders share my deep appreciation for the close friendship between our two nations.
quotes.author: Lincoln Chafee

quotes.quote: What gay culture is before it is anything else, before it is a culture of desire or a culture of subversion or a culture of pain, is a culture of friendship.
quotes.author: Andrew Sullivan

quotes.quote: Holding Eleanor's hand was like holding a butterfly. Or a heartbeat. Like holding something complete, and completely alive.
quotes.author: Rainbow Rowell,  Eleanor & Park

quotes.quote: But it all comes down to friendship, treating people right.
quotes.author: Ernie Banks

quotes.quote: Suspicion is the cancer of friendship.
quotes.author: Petrarch

quotes.quote: Friendship is two-sided. It isn't a friend just because someone's doing something nice for you. That's a nice person. There's friendship when you do for each other. It's like marriage - it's two-sided.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: Before the flowers of friendship faded friendship faded.
quotes.author: Gertrude Stein

quotes.quote: My first experiences of academic friendship made me smile in after years when I looked back on them. But my circle of acquaintances had gradually grown so large that it was only natural new friendships should grow out of it.
quotes.author: Georg Brandes

quotes.quote: When I say it's you I like, I'm talking about that part of you that knows that life is far more than anything you can ever see or hear or touch. That deep part of you that allows you to stand for those things without which humankind cannot survive. Love that conquers hate, peace that rises triumphant over war, and justice that proves more powerful than greed.
quotes.author: Fred Rogers

quotes.quote: If the chemistry is right between star and photographer and the geometry of the pictures pleases the star, often the two people end up with a long-term professional friendship during which they continue to work together and to produce highly personal images.
quotes.author: Eve Arnold

quotes.quote: I want to grow a flower for every time someone tells me 'F*** you.' Then I'll go back to that person and pin the flower on their lapel in a gesture of friendship. And while they are looking down on it in astonishment, I'll bunch up my knuckles and punch them in the face.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want Two apply for a job at our country's largest funeral home, and then wear a suit and noose to the job interview.

quotes.quote: People have forgotten this truth,"the fox said. "But you mustn't forget it. You become responsible forever for what you've tamed. You're responsible for your rose.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-ExupÃ©ry,  The Little Prince

quotes.quote: Anybody can sympathise with the sufferings of a friend, but it requires a very fine nature to sympathise with a friend's success.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Friendship is an arrangement by which we undertake to exchange small favors for big ones.
quotes.author: Charles de Montesquieu

quotes.quote: When David Fincher called me up a few years ago and said, 'Hey, I'd like you to score this film 'The Social Network,' I said, 'I'm flattered, but I really don't have any real experience scoring films, and I'd rather not screw it up on a high-profile project. And I like you and I don't want to compromise our friendship.'
quotes.author: Trent Reznor

quotes.quote: Stay is a charming word in a friend's vocabulary.
quotes.author: Amos Bronson Alcott,  Concord Days

quotes.quote: Primarily, 'Black Girl/White Girl' is the story of two very different, yet somehow 'fated' girls; for Genna, her 'friendship' with Minette is the most haunting of her life, though it is one-sided and ends in tragedy.
quotes.author: Joyce Carol Oates

quotes.quote: You can go through life and make new friends every year - every month practically - but there was never any substitute for those friendships of childhood that survive into adult years. Those are the ones in which we are bound to one another with hoops of steel.
quotes.author: Alexander McCall Smith,  The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency

quotes.quote: Often the magical elements in my books are standing in for elements of the real world, the small and magical-in-their-own-right sorts of things that we take for granted and no longer pay attention to, like the bonds of friendship that entwine our own lives with those of other people and places.
quotes.author: Charles de Lint

quotes.quote: I have enjoyed most particularly reading the correspondence between Gustav Mahler and Richard Strauss. The genuine friendship, competitiveness and support that thread through their communications are life lessons for us all.
quotes.author: Jessye Norman

quotes.quote: Friendship is like money, easier made than kept.
quotes.author: Samuel Butler

quotes.quote: Acquaintances we meet, enjoy, and can easily leave behind; but friendship grows deep roots.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quotes.quote: I keep my friends as misers do their treasure, because, of all the things granted us by wisdom, none is greater or better than friendship.
quotes.author: Pietro Aretino

quotes.quote: I had three chairs in my house; one for solitude, two for friendship, three for society.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: Even in the common affairs of life, in love, friendship, and marriage, how little security have we when we trust our happiness in the hands of others!
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: Business, you know, may bring you money, but friendship hardly ever does.
quotes.author: Jane Austen

quotes.quote: If you're going through friendship issues, I would say, first of all take a step back. How important is the friendship to you? Sometimes, if someone's not being a good friend to you and isn't treating you the way you should be treated, then you kind of have to move on sometimes.
quotes.author: Victoria Justice

quotes.quote: The differences between friends cannot but reinforce their friendship.
quotes.author: Mao Zedong

quotes.quote: I've got some great guy friends. They can start out as crushes. But when you realize something isn't going to happen, you make a choice whether or not the friendship is worth it. And it usually is. Then you can laugh about the fact that you used to have a crush on him or he had one on you.
quotes.author: Courteney Cox

quotes.quote: I force people to have coffee with me, just because I don't trust that a friendship can be maintained without any other senses besides a computer or cellphone screen.
quotes.author: John Cusack

quotes.quote: A tree is known by its fruit; a man by his deeds. A good deed is never lost; he who sows courtesy reaps friendship, and he who plants kindness gathers love.
quotes.author: Saint Basil

quotes.quote: Tis the privilege of friendship to talk nonsense, and have her nonsense respected.
quotes.author: Charles Lamb

quotes.quote: I do have a lot of time for people in my life, and friendship is a very important subject for me. I think I'm unusual among the writers I know in that respect.
quotes.author: Salman Rushdie

quotes.quote: I have a couple of best friends, and I don't think I would live with them. It definitely... certain people can't live together, and I think that it could potentially put a lot of strain on the relationship or friendship.
quotes.author: Alexandra Chando

quotes.quote: I came to Venice for the first time in 1968 and was lucky enough to make the acquaintanceship, and then the friendship, of two Venetians, Roberta and Franco, who remain my best friends here after almost 50 years.
quotes.author: Donna Leon

quotes.quote: What I cannot love, I overlook. Is that real friendship?
quotes.author: Anais Nin

quotes.quote: Love is rarer than genius itself. And friendship is rarer than love.
quotes.author: Charles Peguy

quotes.quote: Friends confront each other sometimes, and sometimes the friendship lasts, and sometimes it doesn't.
quotes.author: Brooke Elliott

quotes.quote: Friendship is but another name for an alliance with the follies and the misfortunes of others. Our own share of miseries is sufficient: why enter then as volunteers into those of another?
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: My inspiration are the woman, friendship, and loneliness.
quotes.author: Enrique Iglesias

quotes.quote: A traitor is a betrayer - one who practices injury, while professing friendship. Benedict Arnold was a traitor, solely because, while professing friendship for the American cause, he attempted to injure it. An open enemy, however criminal in other respects, is no traitor.
quotes.author: Lysander Spooner

quotes.quote: Love is friendship that has caught fire. It is quiet understanding, mutual confidence, sharing and forgiving. It is loyalty through good and bad times. It settles for less than perfection and makes allowances for human weaknesses.
quotes.author: Ann Landers

quotes.quote: Poor France, thy fine climate, rich vineyards, and the wishes of the learned avail nothing; thou art a destitute beggar, and not the powerful friend thou wert represented to me.
quotes.author: John James Audubon

quotes.quote: Friendship has always belonged to the core of my spiritual journey.
quotes.author: Henri Nouwen

quotes.quote: People come in and out of our lives, and the true test of friendship is whether you can pick back up right where you left off the last time you saw each other.
quotes.author: Lisa See

quotes.quote: Friendship is a wildly underrated medication.
quotes.author: Anna Deavere Smith

quotes.quote: Forgiveness is that subtle thread that binds both love and friendship. Without forgiveness, you may not even have a child one day.
quotes.author: George Foreman

quotes.quote: Only solitary men know the full joys of friendship. Others have their family; but to a solitary and an exile his friends are everything.
quotes.author: Warren G. Harding

quotes.quote: Life is all about the friendship and the love and the music. It sounds silly, but it is. I want to have that experience as much as I can as an adult, not as a kid doing something that people are telling her she has to do. If anyone gets in my way, I'm going to get them out of my way.
quotes.author: Fiona Apple

quotes.quote: Faith is salted and peppered through everything at Christmas. And I love at least one night by the Christmas tree to sing and feel the quiet holiness of that time that's set apart to celebrate love, friendship, and God's gift of the Christ child.
quotes.author: Amy Grant

quotes.quote: At the beginning of the new century, it is the common aspiration of the peoples of the two countries to deepen mutual understanding, enhance trust, develop friendship and strengthen cooperation.
quotes.author: Li Peng

quotes.quote: In my public service, I treasure my friendship with law enforcement officers. I admire what they do and support them in every aspect of their job. I have always looked upon law enforcement officers as my friends.
quotes.author: Dirk Kempthorne

quotes.quote: Friendship, like the immortality of the soul, is too good to be believed.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: I sacrificed a lot, in terms of friendship and family, from working so much at such a young age, but I wouldn't be where I am if I hadn't.
quotes.author: Sasha Grey

quotes.quote: Be true to yourself, help others, make each day your masterpiece, make friendship a fine art, drink deeply from good books - especially the Bible, build a shelter against a rainy day, give thanks for your blessings and pray for guidance every day.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: Although the troops have struck us, we throw it all behind and are glad to meet you in peace and friendship.
quotes.author: Black Kettle

quotes.quote: Accountability in friendship is the equivalent of love without strategy.
quotes.author: Anita Brookner

quotes.quote: Friendship is one of the most tangible things in a world which offers fewer and fewer supports.
quotes.author: Kenneth Branagh

quotes.quote: There is nothing like puking with somebody to make you into old friends.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath,  The Bell Jar

quotes.quote: Taft was Roosevelt's handpicked successor. I didn't know how deep the friendship was between the two men until I read their almost four hundred letters, stretching back the to early '30s. It made me realize the heartbreak when they ruptured was much more than a political division.
quotes.author: Doris Kearns Goodwin

quotes.quote: My aim is to create a happy society with genuine friendship. Friendship between Tibetan and Chinese peoples is very essential.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: Few things tend more to alienate friendship than a want of punctuality in our engagements. I have known the breach of a promise to dine or sup to break up more than one intimacy.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: Love is like a friendship caught on fire. In the beginning a flame, very pretty, often hot and fierce, but still only light and flickering. As love grows older, our hearts mature and our love becomes as coals, deep-burning and unquenchable.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee
