quotes.quote: On one side, citizens have great respect for the United States; they have a great feeling of friendship. That is solid. But in the opposition and in the political arena I often find criticism of the closeness of relations with the United States. That is a reality.
quotes.author: Vicente Fox

quotes.quote: Why are old lovers able to become friends? Two reasons. They never truly loved each other, or they love each other still.
quotes.author: Whitney Otto,  How to Make an American Quilt

quotes.quote: Friendship is a plant of slow growth and must undergo and withstand the shocks of adversity before it is entitled to the appellation.
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.quote: Why do we go around acting as though everything was friendship and reliability when basically everything everywhere is full of sudden hate and ugliness?
quotes.author: Anna Freud

quotes.quote: That's what people do who love you. They put their arms around you and love you when you're not so lovable.
quotes.author: Deb Caletti

quotes.quote: Friendship can only exist between persons with similar interests and points of view. Man and woman by the conventions of society are born with different interests and different points of view.
quotes.author: August Strindberg

quotes.quote: Look, I worked with American Republican presidents and Democratic presidents, all of them, and each of them has shown a deep and profound friendship to Israel, you know? I can't remember anybody who was in that sense negative as far as Israel is concerned.
quotes.author: Shimon Peres

quotes.quote: Your experiences will be yours alone. But truth and best friendship will rarely if ever disappoint you.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: Trust no friend without faults, and love a woman, but no angel.
quotes.author: Doris Lessing

quotes.quote: Among young people, often a key factor in them committing suicide is the trauma of transient relationships. They throw themselves into a friendship or network of friendships, then it collapses and they're desolate.
quotes.author: Vincent Nichols

quotes.quote: Friendship, like love, is destroyed by long absence, though it may be increased by short intermissions.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: General benevolence, but not general friendship, made a man what he ought to be.
quotes.author: Jane Austen

quotes.quote: As I grow older, I think friendship between women is a thing to cherish.
quotes.author: Susan Glaspell

quotes.quote: I am deeply spiritual; I revel in those things that make for good - the things that we can do to shed a little light, to help place an oft-dissonant universe back in tune with itself... Long live art, long live friendship, long live the joy of life!
quotes.author: Jessye Norman

quotes.quote: No matter what message you are about to deliver somewhere, whether it is holding out a hand of friendship, or making clear that you disapprove of something, is the fact that the person sitting across the table is a human being, so the goal is to always establish common ground.
quotes.author: Madeleine Albright

quotes.quote: Those who insist on having hostilities with us, kill and destroy the option of friendship with us in the future, which is unfortunate because it is clear the future belongs to Iran and that enmities will be fruitless.
quotes.author: Mahmoud Ahmadinejad

quotes.quote: I can tell you, dearest friend, that if it became known how much friendship, love and a world of human and spiritual references I have smuggled into these three movements, the adherents of programme music - should there be any left - would go mad with joy.
quotes.author: Alban Berg

quotes.quote: It's bullshit to think of friendship and romance as being different. They're not. They're just variations of the same love. Variations of the same desire to be close.
quotes.author: Rachel Cohn,  Naomi and Ely's No Kiss List

quotes.quote: Marriage: A friendship recognized by the police.
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quotes.quote: In friendship as well as love, ignorance very often contributes more to our happiness than knowledge.
quotes.author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: It may be a cold, clammy thing to say, but those that treat friendship the same as any other selfishness seem to get the most out of it.
quotes.author: E. W. Howe

quotes.quote: To like and dislike the same things, this is what makes a solid friendship.
quotes.author: Sallust

quotes.quote: I'm calling my book series the 'with God series.' And this next 'with God' book is Friendship with God, which comes out in November. This books challenges us to bring about the end of 'better' on this planet.
quotes.author: Neale Donald Walsch

quotes.quote: The building of friendship, family, community and love is complicated. We are so isolated in this country, no longer supported by tribes and villages.
quotes.author: Jasmine Guy

quotes.quote: Men and women can absolutely be friends, and that's what we need to be. Part of the problem is that we aren't friends enough. Our relationships are negotiations, and that is not friendship.
quotes.author: Hill Harper

quotes.quote: One sure way to lose another woman's friendship is to try to improve her flower arrangements.
quotes.author: Marcelene Cox

quotes.quote: Nobody ever chooses the already unfortunate as objects of his loyal friendship.
quotes.author: Lucan

quotes.quote: Is it possible, in the final analysis, for one human being to achieve perfect understanding of another?We can invest enormous time and energy in serious efforts to know another person, but in the end, how close can we come to that person's essence? We convince ourselves that we know the other person well, but do we really know anything important about anyone?
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle

quotes.quote: Anything can be done if you find friends to do it with. The lucky biographers find themselves drawn into a sort of friendship with their subject.
quotes.author: Amity Shlaes

quotes.quote: 'Mistresses' is about the lives of four women, each going through different versions of infidelity. Their longtime friendship is what gets them through extremely challenging times.
quotes.author: Rochelle Aytes

quotes.quote: I am awfully greedy; I want everything from life. I want to be a woman and to be a man, to have many friends and to have loneliness, to work much and write good books, to travel and enjoy myself, to be selfish and to be unselfish... You see, it is difficult to get all which I want. And then when I do not succeed I get mad with anger.
quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir

quotes.quote: I didn't have any Indigenous friends until I was in my 30s, and I'll always remember and be inspired by the remarkable friendship I had with Connie Bush, an outstanding Indigenous leader from Groot Eylandt on who was on the National Women's Advisory Council with me.
quotes.author: Quentin Bryce

quotes.quote: Marriage, for a woman at least, hampers the two things that made life to me glorious - friendship and learning.
quotes.author: Jane Harrison

quotes.quote: A passion for politics stems usually from an insatiable need, either for power, or for friendship and adulation, or a combination of both.
quotes.author: Fawn M. Brodie

quotes.quote: I think it's important to have closure in any relationship that ends - from a romantic relationship to a friendship. You should always have a sense of clarity at the end and know why it began and why it ended. You need that in your life to move cleanly into your next phase.
quotes.author: Jennifer Aniston

quotes.quote: Great is the victory, but the friendship of all is greater.
quotes.author: Emil Zatopek

quotes.quote: Friendship is a difficult, dangerous job. It is also (though we rarely admit it) extremely exhausting.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Bibesco

quotes.quote: China has been committed to the independent foreign policy of peace and has developed friendship and cooperation with all countries on the basis of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence.
quotes.author: Hu Jintao

quotes.quote: 'Safe Harbor' is a state of mind... it's the place - in reality or metaphor - to which one goes in times of trouble or worry. It can be a friendship, marriage, church, garden, beach, poem, prayer, or song.
quotes.author: Luanne Rice

quotes.quote: Friendship is almost always the union of a part of one mind with the part of another; people are friends in spots.
quotes.author: George Santayana

quotes.quote: Friendship is also about liking a person for their failings, their weakness. It's also about mutual help, not about exploitation.
quotes.author: Paul Theroux

quotes.quote: To say that one waits a lifetime for his soulmate to come around is a paradox. People eventually get sick of waiting, take a chance on someone, and by the art of commitment become soulmates, which takes a lifetime to perfect.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: Laughter is not a bad beginning for a friendship, and it is the best ending for one.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: Caring for but never trying to own may be a further way to define friendship.
quotes.author: William Glasser

quotes.quote: Time makes friendship stronger, but love weaker.
quotes.author: Jean de la Bruyere

quotes.quote: As soon as you try to describe a close friendship, it loses something.
quotes.author: Dean Smith

quotes.quote: It's so curious: one can resist tears and 'behave' very well in the hardest hours of grief. But then someone makes you a friendly sign behind a window, or one notices that a flower that was in bud only yesterday has suddenly blossomed, or a letter slips from a drawer... and everything collapses.
quotes.author: Colette

quotes.quote: Friendship is mutual blackmail elevated to the level of love.
quotes.author: Robin Morgan

quotes.quote: Success always necessitates a degree of ruthlessness. Given the choice of friendship or success, I'd probably choose success.
quotes.author: Sting

quotes.quote: I have lost my seven best friends, which is to say God has had mercy on me seven times without realizing it. He lent a friendship, took it from me, sent me another.
quotes.author: Jean Cocteau

quotes.quote: The ideal friendship is to feel as one while remaining two.
quotes.author: Sophie Swetchine

quotes.quote: Friendship is something that creates equality and mutuality, not a reward for finding equality or a way of intensifying existing mutuality.
quotes.author: Rowan Williams

quotes.quote: I have a very close friendship with the skaters.
quotes.author: Eric Heiden

quotes.quote: I would like to raise my glass to friendship between Russia and the United States.
quotes.author: Richard Lugar

quotes.quote: I think that different pleasures work for different readers - a friend of mine won't read anything that's not a cardiovascular sort of page-turner. I tend to care less about plot, but I'm a sucker for humor and strangeness.
quotes.author: Karen Russell

quotes.quote: Sweet is the scene where genial friendship plays the pleasing game of interchanging praise.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Sr.

quotes.quote: My heart is warm with the friends I make,And better friends I'll not be knowing,Yet there isn't a train I wouldn't take,No matter where it's going.
quotes.author: Edna St. Vincent Millay,  The Selected Poetry

quotes.quote: I take friendship very seriously.
quotes.author: Wole Soyinka

quotes.quote: I didn't like England. I couldn't take the look of the place or the style of friendship. I need more intimacy from people than is considered okay there, and I felt that my personality and my enthusiasms weren't understood. I had to put a big lid on myself.
quotes.author: Jane Campion

quotes.quote: Be slow to fall into friendship; but when thou art in, continue firm and constant.
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.quote: We always see our worst selves. Our most vulnerable selves. We need someone else to get close enough to tell us we're wrong. Someone we trust.
quotes.author: David Levithan,  Naomi and Ely's No Kiss List

quotes.quote: China-Africa relationship has a long history and is full of vitality. Since the 1950s and 1960s, our common historical experiences have brought China and Africa together, and we have forged deep friendship in our joint struggle during which we have supported each other in times of difficulty.
quotes.author: Li Keqiang

quotes.quote: It will give them the opportunity to show themselves worthy of the respect and friendship of peace-loving nations, and in time, to take an honorable place among members of the United Nations.
quotes.author: James F. Byrnes

quotes.quote: I love 'Curb Your Enthusiasm' and 'Extras' and also 'The Trip.' That had all the nuances of friendship and finding things out about their lives without it being too much plot-driven.
quotes.author: Dolly Wells

quotes.quote: Friendship is something whose depth fits human aspirations and fulfills human possibilities. It has heft to it, as a gold-piece does and a gambling chip does not.
quotes.author: Eugene Kennedy

quotes.quote: Our true friends are those who are with us when the good things happen. They cheer us on and are pleased by our triumphs. False friends only appear at difficult times, with their sad, supportive faces, when, in fact, our suffering is serving to console them for their miserable lives.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Zahir

quotes.quote: November 11, 1802, I arrived at Judge Patterson's at Lisle. This respectable family treated me with every mark of distinction and friendship, and likewise all the people did the same. I really want for words to express my gratitude.
quotes.author: Deborah Sampson

quotes.quote: I think 'Pretty Little Liars' is going to be hugely popular for adults, for kids, for girls, for guys, you know, something for everyone to look at, and the stories are going to be great. There's suspense every week. The friendship is really fun to watch. I think it's going to have something for everybody.
quotes.author: Laura Leighton

quotes.quote: I may not always be with you But when we're far apartRemember you will be with meRight inside my heart
quotes.author: Marc Wambolt,  Poems from the Heart

quotes.quote: A true friend never gets in your way unless you happen to be going down.
quotes.author: Arnold H. Glasow

quotes.quote: A true friend is one who overlooks your failures and tolerates your success!
quotes.author: Doug Larson

quotes.quote: A friend is a gift you give yourself.
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quotes.quote: When a girl says she wants to be friends with benefits, I always ask if that includes dental insurance.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  It Occurred to Me

quotes.quote: When a woman becomes her own best friend life is easier.
quotes.author: Diane Von Furstenberg

quotes.quote: Each friend represents a world in us, a world not born until they arrive, and it is only by this meeting that a new world is born.
quotes.author: Anais Nin

quotes.quote: The world is round so that friendship may encircle it.
quotes.author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

quotes.quote: Like all of my friends, she's a lousy judge of character.
quotes.author: David Sedaris,  Me Talk Pretty One Day

quotes.quote: True friendship can afford true knowledge. It does not depend on darkness and ignorance.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: False friendship, like the ivy, decays and ruins the walls it embraces; but true friendship gives new life and animation to the object it supports.
quotes.author: Richard Burton

quotes.quote: A friendship founded on business is better than a business founded on friendship.
quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller

quotes.quote: Since there is nothing so well worth having as friends, never lose a chance to make them.
quotes.author: Francesco Guicciardini

quotes.quote: There is no friend like an old friend who has shared our morning days, no greeting like his welcome, no homage like his praise.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Sr.

quotes.quote: Some people go to priests; others to poetry; I to my friends.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf

quotes.quote: Friendship will not stand the strain of very much good advice for very long.
quotes.author: Robert Staughton Lynd

quotes.quote: Nothing but heaven itself is better than a friend who is really a friend.
quotes.author: Plautus

quotes.quote: Instead of loving your enemies - treat your friends a little better.
quotes.author: E. W. Howe

quotes.quote: Where would you be without friends? The people to pick you up when you need lifting? We come from homes far from perfect, so you end up almost parent and sibling to your friends - your own chosen family. There's nothing like a really loyal, dependable, good friend. Nothing.
quotes.author: Jennifer Aniston

quotes.quote: Lovers have a right to betray you... friends don't.
quotes.author: Judy Holliday

quotes.quote: It is easy enough to be friendly to one's friends. But to befriend the one who regards himself as your enemy is the quintessence of true religion. The other is mere business.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Our most intimate friend is not he to whom we show the worst, but the best of our nature.
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.quote: A good writer possesses not only his own spirit but also the spirit of his friends.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Never do a wrong thing to make a friend or to keep one.
quotes.author: Robert E. Lee

quotes.quote: You win the victory when you yield to friends.
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.quote: Never have a companion that casts you in the shade.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracian

quotes.quote: Be slow in choosing a friend, slower in changing.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: Mighty proud I am that I am able to have a spare bed for my friends.
quotes.author: Samuel Pepys

quotes.quote: She is a friend of my mind. She gather me, man. The pieces I am, she gather them and give them back to me in all the right order.
quotes.author: Toni Morrison,  Beloved

quotes.quote: Fear makes strangers of people who would be friends.
quotes.author: Shirley MacLaine

quotes.quote: Rejoicing in our joy, not suffering over our suffering, makes someone a friend.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: The two most misused words in the entire English vocabulary are love and friendship. A true friend would die for you, so when you start trying to count them on one hand, you don't need any fingers.
quotes.author: Larry Flynt

quotes.quote: Many a person has held close, throughout their entire lives, two friends that always remained strange to one another, because one of them attracted by virtue of similarity, the other by difference.
quotes.author: Emil Ludwig

quotes.quote: No human relation gives one possession in another--every two souls are absolutely different. In friendship or in love, the two side by side raise hands together to find what one cannot reach alone.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran

quotes.quote: Friends are the family you choose (~ Nin/Ithilnin, Elven rogue).
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Other Side of Life

quotes.quote: Friendship is a pretty full-time occupation if you really are friendly with somebody. You can't have too many friends because then you're just not really friends.
quotes.author: Truman Capote

quotes.quote: Friendship, of itself a holy tie, is made more sacred by adversity.
quotes.author: Charles Caleb Colton

quotes.quote: Every friendship goes through ups and downs. Dysfunctional patterns set in; external situations cause internal friction; you grow apart and then bounce back together.
quotes.author: Mariella Frostrup

quotes.quote: To be poor does not mean you lack the means to extend charity to another. You may lack money or food, but you have the gift of friendship to overwhelm the loneliness that grips the lives of so many.
quotes.author: Stanley Hauerwas

quotes.quote: Friendship is a disinterested commerce between equals; love, an abject intercourse between tyrants and slaves.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You walked away from gossip and verbal defamation? Let today be the day...You speak only the good you know of other people and encourage others to do the same.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: A friend is a beloved mystery; dearest always because he is not ourself, and has something in him which it is impossible for us to fathom. If it were not so, friendship would lose its chief zest.
quotes.author: Lucy Larcom

quotes.quote: Even an animal, if you show genuine affection, gradually trust develops... If you always showing bad face and beating, how can you develop friendship?
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: Friendship is the marriage of the soul, and this marriage is liable to divorce.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: The greatest sweetener of human life is Friendship. To raise this to the highest pitch of enjoyment, is a secret which but few discover.
quotes.author: Joseph Addison

quotes.quote: Most people are enduring a marginalized isolation. One of the great obstacles to modern friendships is the 'religion of rush.' People are rushing all the time through time. Friendship takes time.
quotes.author: John O'Donohue

quotes.quote: People are roasting each other at parties, at work events, around the fire. It's so fun. People are busting each other's chops, and it's a sign of affection, truly. It's a true test of love and friendship: can you make a man laugh at himself? So what makes a good burn? Go after targets you love and respect. And hit 'em hard.
quotes.author: Jeff Ross

quotes.quote: For me my friendship with Omar Rodriguez from Mars Volta that friendship really means a lot to me because he's another creative person who works as hard as I do.
quotes.author: John Frusciante

quotes.quote: It is one of the severest tests of friendship to tell your friend his faults. So to love a man that you cannot bear to see a stain upon him, and to speak painful truth through loving words, that is friendship.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: Love is friendship set on fire.
quotes.author: Jeremy Taylor

quotes.quote: I made my first white women friends in college; they loved me and were loyal to our friendship, but I understood, as they did, that they were white women and that whiteness mattered.
quotes.author: Alice Walker

quotes.quote: Inventory:"Four be the things I am wiser to know:Idleness, sorrow, a friend, and a foe.Four be the things I'd been better without:Love, curiosity, freckles, and doubt.Three be the things I shall never attain:Envy, content, and sufficient champagne.Three be the things I shall have till I die:Laughter and hope and a sock in the eye.
quotes.author: Dorothy Parker,  The Complete Poems of Dorothy Parker

quotes.quote: It is difficult to obtain the friendship of a cat. It is a philosophical animal... one that does not place its affections thoughtlessly.
quotes.author: Theophile Gautier

quotes.quote: If you hang out with chickens, you're going to cluck and if you hang out with eagles, you're going to fly.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Are you upset little friend? Have you been lying awake worrying? Well, don't worry...I'm here. The flood waters will recede, the famine will end, the sun will shine tomorrow, and I will always be here to take care of you.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: We must reach out our hand in friendship and dignity both to those who would befriend us and those who would be our enemy.
quotes.author: Arthur Ashe

quotes.quote: The rule of friendship means there should be mutual sympathy between them, each supplying what the other lacks and trying to benefit the other, always using friendly and sincere words.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: Love and friendship exclude each other.
quotes.author: Jean de la Bruyere

quotes.quote: There is something in the unselfish and self-sacrificing love of a brute, which goes directly to the heart of him who has had frequent occasion to test the paltry friendship and gossamer fidelity of mere Man.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: I knew they would kill me when they found out, but...' He struggled for words, releasing a sharp breath. 'I think I realized that I would rather die because I betrayed them, than live because I betrayed you.
quotes.author: Marissa Meyer,  Scarlet

quotes.quote: When I was growing up, my mother was always a friend to my siblings and me (in addition to being all the other things a mom is), and I was always grateful for that because I knew she was someone I could talk to and joke with, and argue with and that nothing would ever harm that friendship.
quotes.author: Marlo Thomas

quotes.quote: Secrecy is the chastity of friendship.
quotes.author: Jeremy Taylor

quotes.quote: There are no coincidences in life. What person that wandered in and out of your life was there for some purpose, even if they caused you harm. Sometimes, it doesn't make sense the short periods of time we get with people, or the outcomes from their choices. However, if you turn it over to God he promises that you will see the big picture in the hereafter. Nothing is too small to be a mistake.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: A friend is an emotional bond, just like friendship is a human experience.
quotes.author: Simon Sinek

quotes.quote: A fit, healthy body--that is the best fashion statement
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott

quotes.quote: I noticed that no matter where I went in the country, there was this group of questions that got asked. I would track them and keep them in categories. Like body image, school, family, friendship, you name it, the emotional life of a teenage girl.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Berkley

quotes.quote: I love the fact that so many of my readers are intelligent, exceptional, accomplished people with an open-minded love of diversity. But even more than that, I love it when my readers find lasting friendship with others of my readers - knowing that they met through their mutual affection for my books and characters makes me happy!
quotes.author: Suzanne Brockmann

quotes.quote: This book taught me, once and for all, how easily you can escape this world with the help of words! You can find friends between the pages of a book, wonderful friends.
quotes.author: Cornelia Funke,  Inkspell

quotes.quote: Friendship has its illusions no less than love.
quotes.author: Stendhal

quotes.quote: When two people first meet, they can only have a very ordinary kind of friendship. But when you begin to understand each other, when you get close to them, you discover that you're suddenly eager to know him or her even better.
quotes.author: Zhang Ziyi

quotes.quote: It must be remembered that the sea is a great breeder of friendship. Two men who have known each other for twenty years find that twenty days at sea bring them nearer than ever they were before, or else estrange them.
quotes.author: Gilbert Parker

quotes.quote: True friendship multiplies the good in life and divides its evils. Strive to have friends, for life without friends is like life on a desert island... to find one real friend in a lifetime is good fortune; to keep him is a blessing.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracian

quotes.quote: No man can be called friendless who has God and the companionship of good books.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quotes.quote: Read as you taste fruit or savor wine, or enjoy friendship, love or life.
quotes.author: George Herbert

quotes.quote: Friendship is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
quotes.author: Plautus

quotes.quote: During the 1950s, Aristotle Onassis and I formed what grew to be a close friendship and association in several business ventures.
quotes.author: J. Paul Getty

quotes.quote: I think in friendship, you want to be there for your friend, and sometimes you just don't know what to do or the relationship you have with them is not clear enough for you to know what to do.
quotes.author: Marion Cotillard

quotes.quote: The little trouble in the world that is not due to love is due to friendship.
quotes.author: E. W. Howe

quotes.quote: Came but for friendship, and took away love.
quotes.author: Thomas Moore

quotes.quote: The firmest friendship is based on an identity of likes and dislikes.
quotes.author: Sallust

quotes.quote: I'm quite obsessed with the idea of nailing the girl friendship. It's such an art, so delicate.
quotes.author: Alanis Morissette

quotes.quote: I want to use my connections with coaches, players, celebrities, whomever, and if I can take that friendship and use it to help someone else, I'm going to take advantage of that. I'm not going to apologize for that.
quotes.author: Tim Tebow

quotes.quote: We come into relationships often very much identified with our needs. I need this, I need security, I need refuge, I need friendship. And all of relationships are symbiotic in that sense. We come together because we fulfill each others' needs at some level or other.
quotes.author: Ram Dass

quotes.quote: I don't want to hurt you or anybody so please forget about me. Just try. Find yourself a better friend.
quotes.author: Nina LaCour,  Hold Still

quotes.quote: Conjugal love, or the friendship of spouses, can persist even after sexual desires have weakened, withered, and disappeared.
quotes.author: Mortimer Adler

quotes.quote: Aristotle uses a mother's love for her child as the prime example of love or friendship.
quotes.author: Mortimer Adler

quotes.quote: You've got to reach a hand of friendship across the aisle and across philosophies in this country.
quotes.author: Joe Biden

quotes.quote: To some it may be a thrill to be known, to me it's a thrill to start a friendship even up.
quotes.author: Christopher Knight

quotes.quote: Things that matter are not easy. Feelings of happiness are easy. Happiness is not. Flirting is easy. Love is not. Saying you're friends is easy. Being friends is not.
quotes.author: David Levithan,  Naomi and Ely's No Kiss List

quotes.quote: A wise man gets more use from his enemies than a fool from his friends.
quotes.author: Baltasar GraciÃ¡n,  The Art of Worldly Wisdom

quotes.quote: I've learned that friendship does not equate business, business does not equate friendship.
quotes.author: Jill Scott

quotes.quote: Colpo di fulmine. The thunderbolt, as Italians call it. When love strikes someone like lightning, so powerful and intense it can't be denied. It's beautiful and messy,cracking a chest open and spilling their soul out for the world to see. It turns a person inside out, and there's no going back from it. Once the thunderbolt hits, your life isirrevocably changed.
quotes.author: J.M. Darhower,  Sempre

quotes.quote: V-Day...if you need this one day in a year to show everyone else you truly care for 'your loved one' I think it's quite stupid. I hate this commercialism. It's all artificial, and has nothing to do with real love.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel

quotes.quote: I really think that technology has the greatest potential to accelerate happiness of most things in the world. The companies that will ultimately do well are the companies that chase happiness. If you find a way to help people find love, or health or friendship, the dollar will chase that.
quotes.author: Ashton Kutcher

quotes.quote: All who consult on doubtful matters, should be void of hatred, friendship, anger, and pity.
quotes.author: Sallust

quotes.quote: There is no happiness like that of being loved by your fellow creatures, and feeling that your presence is an addition to their comfort.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Jane Eyre

quotes.quote: Like any friendship or marriage, familiarity breeds more contempt, and love, and everything.
quotes.author: Martin Freeman

quotes.quote: You had to know a person well to make them laugh like that.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Prince

quotes.quote: One measure of friendship consists not in the number of things friends can discuss, but in the number of things they need no longer mention.
quotes.author: Clifton Fadiman

quotes.quote: I lend people money, but I'd never lend something that would jeopardise a friendship if I didn't get it back.
quotes.author: Paloma Faith

quotes.quote: I mix talents and friendship, which is not very professional, but it's my way of thinking. So I love Azzedine Alaia, because I've known him for 30 years, and he's making my dresses most of the time.
quotes.author: Carine Roitfeld

quotes.quote: Shows like 'Sex and the City' got women involved again in a political way. They were drawn into the personal stories of the four women who together make up one complete cosmopolitan woman. We want to have community, and the show filled that void in our lives: friendship between women.
quotes.author: Kim Cattrall

quotes.quote: No one person can possibly combine all the elements supposed to make up what everyone means by friendship.
quotes.author: Francis Marion Crawford

quotes.quote: A man cannot be said to succeed in this life who does not satisfy one friend.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: Every friendship travels at sometime through the black valley of despair. This tests every aspect of your affection. You lose the attraction and the magic. Your sense of each other darkens and your presence is sore. If you can come through this time, it can purify with your love, and falsity and need will fall away. It will bring you onto new ground where affection can grow again.
quotes.author: John O'Donohue,  Anam Cara: A Book of Celtic Wisdom

quotes.quote: It is not so much our friends' help that helps us, as the confidence of their help.
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.quote: He who hath many friends hath none.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: When you feel someone else's pain and joy as powerfully as if it were your own, then you know you really loved them.
quotes.author: Ann Brashares,  Girls In Pants: The Third Summer of the Sisterhood

quotes.quote: ...Who could refrain, That had a heart to love, and in that heart Courage to make love known?
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Macbeth

quotes.quote: Anything that's human is mentionable, and anything that is mentionable can be more manageable. When we can talk about our feelings, they become less overwhelming, less upsetting, and less scary. The people we trust with that important talk can help us know that we are not alone.
quotes.author: Fred Rogers

quotes.quote: So long as we love we serve; so long as we are loved by others, I would almost say that we are indispensable; and no man is useless while he has a friend.
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  Lay Morals

quotes.quote: If I had to choose between betraying my country and betraying my friend, I hope I should have the guts to betray my country.
quotes.author: E. M. Forster

quotes.quote: A woman may very well form a friendship with a man, but for this to endure, it must be assisted by a little physical antipathy.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Be silent and safe -- silence never betrays you; Be true to your word and your work and your friend; Put least trust in him who is foremost to praise you,Nor judge of a road till it draw to the end.
quotes.author: John Boyle O'Reilly,  Life of John Boyle O'Reilly

quotes.quote: It is an absolute human certainty that no one can know his own beauty or perceive a sense of his own worth until it has been reflected back to him in the mirror of another loving, caring human being.
quotes.author: John Joseph Powell,  The Secret of Staying in Love

quotes.quote: You're such a pain in the ass. (Butch) Said the SIG to the Glock. (V)
quotes.author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Revealed

quotes.quote: Friendship is a strong and habitual inclination in two persons to promote the good and happiness of one another.
quotes.author: Eustace Budgell

quotes.quote: How can sincerity be a condition of friendship? A taste for truth at any cost is a passion which spares nothing.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Friendship with ones self is all important, because without it one cannot be friends with anyone else in the world.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: I hadn't been in proper school in three years. My parents were my two best friends. My third best friend was an author who did not know I existed.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Relationships are all about trust and equality. If one person shares, then the other person should share, too.
quotes.author: Sophie Kinsella,  Can You Keep a Secret?

quotes.quote: From an early age I didn't buy into the value systems of working hard in a nine-to-five job. I thought creativity, friendship and loyalty and pushing the boundaries of what was acceptable was much more interesting.
quotes.author: Adam Clayton

quotes.quote: My head'll explode if I continue with this escapism.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel

quotes.quote: True happiness arises, in the first place, from the enjoyment of one's self, and in the next, from the friendship and conversation of a few select companions.
quotes.author: Joseph Addison

quotes.quote: What do you most value in your friends?Their continued existence.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens,  Hitch-22: A Memoir

quotes.quote: True friendship is a plant of slow growth, and must undergo and withstand the shocks of adversity, before it is entitled to the appellation.
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.quote: The language of Friendship is not words, but meanings.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  A Week on the Concord and Merrimack Rivers

quotes.quote: When you part from your friend, you grieve not;For that which you love most in him may be clearer in his absence, asthe mountain to the climber is clearer from the plain.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

quotes.quote: It's the most exciting thing to watch God work when I've asked him about something, to listen to him and watch him work. It's like this friendship, and it just grows and grows and grows and grows.
quotes.author: Charles R. Swindoll

quotes.quote: Writing is a job, a talent, but it's also the place to go in your head. It is the imaginary friend you drink your tea with in the afternoon.
quotes.author: Ann Patchett,  Truth and Beauty

quotes.quote: Would you rather live one perfect day over and over or live your life with no perfect days but just decent ones?
quotes.author: Jenny Han,  The Summer I Turned Pretty

quotes.quote: I want to be around people that do things. I don't want to be around people anymore that judge or talk about what people do. I want to be around people that dream and support and do things.
quotes.author: Amy Poehler

quotes.quote: Friendship improves happiness and abates misery, by the doubling of our joy and the dividing of our grief.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: The friend in my adversity I shall always cherish most. I can better trust those who helped to relieve the gloom of my dark hours than those who are so ready to enjoy with me the sunshine of my prosperity.
quotes.author: Ulysses S. Grant

quotes.quote: That friendship will not continue to the end which is begun for an end.
quotes.author: Francis Quarles

quotes.quote: I don't need a friend who changes when I change and who nods when I nod; my shadow does that much better.
quotes.author: Plutarch

quotes.quote: The sincere friends of this world are as ship lights in the stormiest of nights.
quotes.author: Giotto di Bondone

quotes.quote: We know from daily life that we exist for other people first of all, for whose smiles and well-being our own happiness depends.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Sweet is the memory of distant friends! Like the mellow rays of the departing sun, it falls tenderly, yet sadly, on the heart.
quotes.author: Washington Irving

quotes.quote: The world is so empty if one thinks only of mountains, rivers & cities; but to know someone who thinks & feels with us, & who, though distant, is close to us in spirit, this makes the earth for us an inhabited garden.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: True friends stab you in the front.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: There used to be days that I thought I was okay, or at least that I was going to be. We'd be hanging out somewhere and everything would just fit right and I would think 'it will be okay if it can just be like this forever' but of course nothing can ever stay just how it is forever.
quotes.author: Nina LaCour,  Hold Still

quotes.quote: A friendship can weather most things and thrive in thin soil; but it needs a little mulch of letters and phone calls and small, silly presents every so often - just to save it from drying out completely.
quotes.author: Pam Brown

quotes.quote: Of all possessions a friend is the most precious.
quotes.author: Herodotus

quotes.quote: It's not your job to like me - it's mine
quotes.author: Byron Katie

quotes.quote: True friendship is like sound health; the value of it is seldom known until it is lost.
quotes.author: Charles Caleb Colton

quotes.quote: A man's friendships are one of the best measures of his worth.
quotes.author: Charles Darwin

quotes.quote: And I'll dance with you in Vienna,I'll be wearing a river's disguise.The hyacinth wild on my shouldermy mouth on the dew of your thighs.And I'll bury my soul in a scrapbook,with the photographs there and the moss.And I'll yield to the flood of your beauty,my cheap violin and my cross.
quotes.author: Leonard Cohen,  Stranger Music: Selected Poems and Songs

quotes.quote: Your truest friends are the ones who will stand by you in your darkest moments--because they're willing to brave the shadows with you--and in your greatest moments--because they're not afraid to let you shine.
quotes.author: Nicole Yatsonsky

quotes.quote: My friends are my estate.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.quote: Maybe you could be mine / or maybe we'll be entwined / aimless in this sexless foreplay.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel

quotes.quote: What is love? two souls and one flesh; friendship? two bodies and one soul.
quotes.author: Joseph Roux

quotes.quote: Because introverts are typically good listeners and, at least, have the appearance of calmness, we are attractive to emotionally needy people. Introverts, gratified that other people are initiating with them, can easily get caught in these exhausting and unsatisfying relationships.
quotes.author: Adam S. McHugh

quotes.quote: A friend is, as it were, a second self.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: I had a second friend come over to my house, and do you know what I called her? A refill. If relationships aren't drinkable, why do we thirst for them so much?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: You might be looking for reasons but there are no reasons.
quotes.author: Nina LaCour,  Hold Still

quotes.quote: A friend in power is a friend lost.
quotes.author: Henry Adams

quotes.quote: We met less than a week ago and in that time I've done nothing but lie and cheat and betray you. I know. But if you give me a chance...all I want is to protect you. To be near you. For as long as I'm able.
quotes.author: Marissa Meyer,  Scarlet

quotes.quote: How delightful to find a friend in everyone.
quotes.author: Joseph Brodsky

quotes.quote: He has no enemies, but is intensely disliked by his friends.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: One's friends are that part of the human race with which one can be human.
quotes.author: George Santayana

quotes.quote: Two things you will never have to chase: True friends & true love.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale

quotes.quote: I hope we'll be friends forever, together we'll always be. I don't think you understand just how much you mean to me. And one day when we part our ways, we'll think back to the past and think about how happy we are 'cause our friendship will always last.
quotes.author: Bridget Davis

quotes.quote: Be courteous to all, but intimate with few, and let those few be well tried before you give them your confidence.
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.quote: Snow is not microwave friendly. In fact, snow is not too friendly at all, unless you first buy it a few beers. Then it's just downright slutty.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If it's very painful for you to criticize your friends - you're safe in doing it. But if you take the slightest pleasure in it, that's the time to hold your tongue.
quotes.author: Alice Miller

quotes.quote: True friends are those who came into your life, saw the most negative part of you, but are not ready to leave you, no matter how contagious you are to them.
quotes.author: Michael Bassey Johnson,  The Infinity Sign

quotes.quote: I hugged him without any kind of fear or self-consciousness, fiercely, with a rush of emotion that almost brought tears to my eyes."I could kiss you!"Chubs cried."Please don't!"I gasp out, feeling his arms tighten around my ribs to the point of cracking them.
quotes.author: Alexandra Bracken,  The Darkest Minds

quotes.quote: The best time to make friends is before you need them.
quotes.author: Ethel Barrymore

quotes.quote: I might have known,' said Eeyore. 'After all, one can't complain. I have my friends. Somebody spoke to me only yesterday. And was it last week or the week before that Rabbit bumped into me and said 'Bother!'. The Social Round. Always something going on.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne,  Winnie-the-Pooh

quotes.quote: True regret is knowing you missed your only opportunity to be simply a good friend to someone that was exactly like you.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: You can always tell a real friend: when you've made a fool of yourself he doesn't feel you've done a permanent job.
quotes.author: Laurence J. Peter

quotes.quote: He brought out the worst in me, and was the best thing that ever happened to me.
quotes.author: Coco J. Ginger

quotes.quote: Love demands infinitely less than friendship.
quotes.author: George Jean Nathan

quotes.quote: Remembering. Forgetting. I'm not sure which is worse.
quotes.author: Kelley Armstrong,  The Calling

quotes.quote: You, of all people, deserve a happy ending. Despite everything that happened to you, you aren't bitter. You aren't cold. You've just retreated a little and been shy, and that's okay. If I were a fairy godmother, I would give you your heart's desire in an istant. And I would wipe away your tears and tell you not to cry.-Rachel to Julia
quotes.author: Sylvain Reynard,  Gabriel's Inferno

quotes.quote: An acquaintance merely enjoys your company, a fair-weather companion flatters when all is well, a true friend has your best interests at heart and the pluck to tell you what you need to hear.
quotes.author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

quotes.quote: Let there be no purpose in friendship save the deepening of the spirit.
quotes.author: Khalil Gibran

quotes.quote: the world is not a pleasant place to be without someone to hold and be held by.
quotes.author: Nikki Giovanni

quotes.quote: Friendship and money: oil and water.
quotes.author: Mario Puzo

quotes.quote: I despise the rituals of fake friendship. I wish we could just claw each other's eyes out and call it a day; instead we put on huge radiant smiles and spout compliments until our teeth hurt from the saccharine sweetness of it all.
quotes.author: Jody Gehrman,  Babe in Boyland

quotes.quote: A friend should be one in whose understanding and virtue we can equally confide, and whose opinion we can value at once for its justness and its sincerity.
quotes.author: Robert Hall

quotes.quote: Time that withers you will wither me. We will fall like ripe fruit and roll down the grass together. Dear friend, let me lie beside you watching the clouds until the earth covers us and we are gone.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson,  Written on the Body

quotes.quote: If you surround yourself with the good and righteous, they can only raise you up. If you surround yourself with the others, they will drag you down into the doldrums of mediocrity, and they will keep you there, but only as long as you permit it.
quotes.author: Mark Glamack

quotes.quote: I don't like my circle of friends, so I'm changing them to a square. Love shapes our lives, so why not shape who we love?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: One's life has value so long as one attributes value to the life of others, by means of love, friendship, and compassion
quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir

quotes.quote: When Ted Williams was here, inducted into the Hall of Fame 37 years ago, he said he must have earned it, because he didn't win it because of his friendship with the writers. I guess in that way, I'm proud to be in this company that way.
quotes.author: Eddie Murray

quotes.quote: Real friendship or love is not manufactured or achieved by an act of will or intention. Friendship is always an act of recognition.
quotes.author: John O'Donohue,  Anam Cara: A Book of Celtic Wisdom

quotes.quote: Everything about her has to do with me.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  The Indigo Spell

quotes.quote: But Piglet is so small that he slips into a pocket, where it is very comfortable to feel him when you are not quite sure whether twice seven is twelve or twenty-two.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne,  Winnie-the-Pooh

quotes.quote: The part which American friendship played in helping us to win the freedom we enjoy in this part of Ireland has been gratefully recognized and acknowledged by our people.
quotes.author: Eamon de Valera

quotes.quote: Friendship is selfless love, care, respect, and honor not a profitable opportunity.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar

quotes.quote: Sport is one of the few spaces where people can learn about different cultures in a spirit of trust and friendship.
quotes.author: Richard Attias

quotes.quote: There is one friend in the life of each of us who seems not a separate person, however dear and beloved, but an expansion, an interpretation, of one's self, the very meaning of one's soul.
quotes.author: Edith Wharton

quotes.quote: Friendship often ends in love. But love in friendship; never.
quotes.author: Charles Caleb Colton

quotes.quote: Only my books anoint me, and a few friends, those who reach into my veins.
quotes.author: Anne Sexton,  The Complete Poems

quotes.quote: I think closeness to death would be pretty exhilarating in a way, and friendship, yeh, and selflessness, a kind of selflessness, a sense of your own worthlessness, I think, is pretty exhilarating.
quotes.author: Sebastian Faulks

quotes.quote: I have two friends, Steve and Martin. But I'd happily replace both for the friendship of Steve Martin.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Eternal

quotes.quote: When I read 'Stand By Me,' it was like, 'This is a look back at the same time period when I was growing up, and it was about kids, but it really felt like what it was like to have those powerful feelings of friendship at age 12.' That's what got to me.
quotes.author: Rob Reiner

quotes.quote: I suppose it's not a social norm, and not a manly thing to do -- to feel, discuss feelings. So that's what I'm giving the finger to. Social norms and stuff...what good are social norms, really? I think all they do is project a limited and harmful image of people. It thus impedes a broader social acceptance of what someone, or a group of people, might actually be like.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  New Order

quotes.quote: Rejection is an opportunity for your selection.
quotes.author: Bernard Branson

quotes.quote: You can love somebody without it being like that. You keep them a stranger, a stranger who's a friend.
quotes.author: Truman Capote,  Breakfast at Tiffany's

quotes.quote: The friendship we share grows amidst the craggy rock pond; reeds of water spray fireflies scented with bonfires.
quotes.author: Bradley Chicho

quotes.quote: You think that holding someone hard will bring them closer. You think that you can hold them so hard that you'll still feel them, embossed on you, when you pull away.Every time Eleanor pulled away from Park, she felt the gasping loss of him.
quotes.author: Rainbow Rowell,  Eleanor & Park

quotes.quote: A real relationship is two-way.
quotes.author: Sophie Kinsella,  Can You Keep a Secret?

quotes.quote: Every life needs a little space. It leaves room for good things to enter it.
quotes.author: Sarah Addison Allen,  The Peach Keeper

quotes.quote: I am proud to represent these men and women who empower people in developing nations and promote the Peace Corps mission of peace and friendship. These volunteers are making major strides to improve the lives of people and communities around the world.
quotes.author: Kenny Marchant

quotes.quote: Mary Lincoln provided Elizabeth Keckley with opportunities for social and economic advancement she probably had never imagined during her years as a slave, while Elizabeth offered Mary the loyal, steadfast friendship she craved but had always found so elusive.
quotes.author: Jennifer Chiaverini

quotes.quote: There are so many men, all endlessly attempting to sweep me off my feet. And there is one of you, trying just the opposite. Making sure my feet are firm beneath me, lest I fall.
quotes.author: Patrick Rothfuss,  The Wise Man's Fear

quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  The Passionate Pilgrim

quotes.quote: I look back now and realize that the gift of a true friend is that she sees you not the way you see yourself or the way others see you. A true friend sees you for who you are and who you can become.
quotes.author: Robin Jones Gunn,  Sisterchicks Say Ooh La La!

quotes.quote: The film itself involves a New York City radio storyteller, Gabriel Noone, who strikes up a friendship with one of his fans, an abused 14-year-old teenager who is suffering from AIDS, who does not have much longer to live.
quotes.author: Armistead Maupin

quotes.quote: You know what the secret is? It's so simple. We love one another. We're nice to one another. Do you know how rare that is? - Carmen
quotes.author: Ann Brashares,  The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants

quotes.quote: Hermione was screaming again: the sound went through Harry like physical pain.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.quote: I believe with all my heart that the cliches are true, that we are our own best friends and best company, and that if you're not right for yourself, it's impossible to be right for anyone.
quotes.author: Rachel Machacek,  The Science of Single: One Woman's Grand Experiment in Modern Dating, Creating Chemistry, and Finding L ove

quotes.quote: My films are always concerned with family, friendship, honor, and patriotism.
quotes.author: John Woo

quotes.quote: Life is partly what we make it, and partly what it is made by the friends we choose.
quotes.author: Tehyi Hsieh

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. And the ageless sages.

quotes.author: Aleksander Kwasniewski

quotes.author: Frances O'Roark Dowell,  The Secret Language of Girls

quotes.author: Sidney Sheldon,  The Other Side of Midnight

quotes.quote: Friendship with a man is friendship with his virtue.

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.author: Lennon Parham

quotes.quote: ...Despite the mayhem that followed, Bruno found that he was still holding Shmuel's hand in his own and nothing in the world would have persuaded him to let go.
quotes.author: John Boyne,  The Boy in the Striped Pajamas

quotes.quote: Going through an illness and then death of a close friend has changed my attitudes to friendship enormously.
quotes.author: Jane Green

quotes.quote: To make real friends you have to put yourself out there. Sometimes people will let you down, but you can't let that stop you. If you get hurt, you just pick yourself up, dust off your feelings, and try again.
quotes.author: Kristin Hannah,  Firefly Lane

quotes.author: Jeff Lemire

quotes.quote: I have no duty to be anyone's Friend and no man in the world has a duty to be mine. No claims, no shadow of necessity. Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art, like the universe itself (for God did not need to create). It has no survival value; rather it is one of those things which give value to survival.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Four Loves

quotes.quote: My writing partner, Nicki, and I became obsessed with a monologist who performs unscripted shows equipped with nothing more than scribbled bullet points and a glass of water. We wrote him a fan letter and found ourselves sharing lunch and eventually a friendship.
quotes.author: Emma McLaughlin

quotes.quote: Oh, brothers! I don't care for brothers. My elder brother won't die, and my younger brothers seem never to do anything else.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

quotes.quote: All love that has not friendship for its base, is like a mansion built upon the sand.
quotes.author: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

quotes.quote: Nobody steals books but your friends.
quotes.author: Roger Zelazny,  The Guns of Avalon

quotes.quote: When you are joyful, when you say yes to life and have fun and project positivity all around you, you become a sun in the center of every constellation, and people want to be near you.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Friendship is a very taxing and arduous form of leisure activity.
quotes.author: Mortimer Adler

quotes.quote: When you ask God for a gift, Be thankful if he sends, Not diamonds, pearls or riches, but the love of real true friends.
quotes.author: Helen Steiner Rice

quotes.quote: Friendship! Mysterious cement of the soul, Sweet'ner of life, and solder of society.
quotes.author: Robert Blair

quotes.quote: True friends will always push you towards the great possibilities of your future, false friends will always chain you to the mistakes in your past.
quotes.author: Seth Brown

quotes.quote: Celebrate the people in your life who are there because they love you for no other reason than because you are YOU.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

quotes.quote: The arrogance that says analysing the relationship between reasons and causes is more important than writing a philosophy of shyness or sadness or friendship drives me nuts. I can't accept that.
quotes.author: Alain de Botton

quotes.quote: Pity and friendship are two passions incompatible with each other.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith

quotes.quote: People with money have to worry about who their real friends are. I don't have that problem for two reasons: I don't have any money, and I don't have any friends.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Nothing of real worth can ever be bought. Love, friendship, honour, valour, respect. All these things have to be earned.
quotes.author: David Gemmell,  Shield of Thunder

quotes.quote: Good fellowship and friendship are lasting, rational and manly pleasures.
quotes.author: William Wycherley

quotes.quote: I am more a friend of art than a producer of painting.
quotes.author: Paul Cezanne

quotes.quote: Anyone who knew the word slattern was worth cultivating as a friend.
quotes.author: Alan Bradley,  The Sweetness at the Bottom of the Pie

quotes.quote: I love everything that is old; old friends, old times, old manners, old books, old wines.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith,  The Vicar of Wakefield

quotes.quote: I have a real problem keeping friends. I'm always running out of space in my freezer.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  There are Two Typos of People in This World: Those Who Can Edit and Those Who Can't

quotes.quote: Peace, commerce and honest friendship with all nations; entangling alliances with none.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: My close friends are fond of telling me that I put the 'yalt' in loyalty. Well, I don't know if I'd go that far with it, but yeah, I guess I am a pretty yalty person.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  There are Two Typos of People in This World: Those Who Can Edit and Those Who Can't

quotes.quote: One of the most mawkish of human delusions is the notion that friendship should be eternal, or, at all events, life-long, and that any act which puts a term to it is somehow discreditable.
quotes.author: H. L. Mencken

quotes.quote: A wise parent humors the desire for independent action, so as to become the friend and advisor when his absolute rule shall cease.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gaskell,  North and South

quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

quotes.quote: My best friend is the man who in wishing me well wishes it for my sake.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: I've become skeptical of the unwritten rule that just because a boy and girl appear in the same feature, a romance must ensue. Rather, I want to portray a slightly different relationship, one where the two mutually inspire each other to live - if I'm able to, then perhaps I'll be closer to portraying a true expression of love.
quotes.author: Hayao Miyazaki

quotes.quote: Of all the means to insure happiness throughout the whole life, by far the most important is the acquisition of friends.
quotes.author: Epicurus,  A Guide To Happiness

quotes.quote: Things are never quite as scary when you've got a best friend.
quotes.author: Bill Watterson

quotes.quote: Soulmate"is an overused term, but a true soul connection is very rare, and very real.
quotes.author: Hilary Duff,  Devoted

quotes.quote: There are still some wonderful people left in this world! They are diamonds in the rough, but they're around! You'll find them when you fall down- they're the ones who pick you up, who don't judge, and you had to fall down to see them! When you get up again, remember who your true friends are!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: For this moment, this one moment, we are together. I press you to me. Come, pain, feed on me. Bury your fangs in my flesh. Tear me asunder. I sob, I sob.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  The Waves

quotes.quote: Friends are born, not made.
quotes.author: Henry Adams

quotes.quote: Never worry alone. When anxiety grabs my mind, it is self-perpetuating. Worrisome thoughts reproduce faster than rabbits, so one of the most powerful ways to stop the spiral of worry is simply to disclose my worry to a friend... The simple act of reassurance from another human being [becomes] a tool of the Spirit to cast out fear -- because peace and fear are both contagious.
quotes.author: John Ortberg Jr.,  The Me I Want to Be: Becoming God's Best Version of You

quotes.quote: A book lying idle on a shelf is wasted ammunition. Like money, books must be kept in constant circulation... A book is not only a friend, it makes friends for you. When you have possessed a book with mind and spirit, you are enriched. But when you pass it on you are enriched threefold.
quotes.author: Henry Miller,  The Books in My Life

quotes.quote: A true friend is someone who is there for you when he'd rather be anywhere else.
quotes.author: Len Wein

quotes.quote: When you loved someone and had to let them go, there will always be that small part of yourself that whispers, "What was it that you wanted and why didn't you fight for it?
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: A friend is one who knows you and loves you just the same.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: A woman can become a man's friend only in the following stages - first an acquantaince, next a mistress, and only then a friend.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov,  The Three Sisters

quotes.quote: A true friend is the greatest of all blessings, and that which we take the least care of all to acquire.
quotes.author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: A few said they'd be horses. Most said they'd be some sort of cat. My friend said she'd like to come back as a porcupine. I don't like crowds, she said.
quotes.author: Brian Andreas

quotes.quote: There is a magnet in your heart that will attract true friends. That magnet is unselfishness, thinking of others first; when you learn to live for others, they will live for you.
quotes.author: Paramahansa Yogananda

quotes.quote: She had to go on this quest. The fate of the world might depend on it. But part of him wanted to say: Forget the world. He didn't want to be without her.
quotes.author: Rick Riordan,  The Mark of Athena

quotes.quote: The friends you make in college are friends you'll have for life, even if you don't talk for years at a time.
quotes.author: Jessica Park,  Flat-Out Love

quotes.quote: A friend is someone who gives you total freedom to be yourself.
quotes.author: Jim Morrison

quotes.quote: With friends, if you keep making an effort to reach out and you keep getting hurt, you eventually stop trying. But it's much harder to give up on family. Somewhere deep down you want it to work so badly that you keep making the same mistake over and over again.
quotes.author: Tori Spelling

quotes.quote: I choose to write because it's perfect for me. It's an escape, a place I can go to hide. It's a friend, when I feel out casted from everyone else. It's a journal, when the only story I can tell is my own. It's a book, when I need to be somewhere else. It's control, when I feel so out of control. It's healing, when everything seems pretty messed up.And it's fun, when life is just flat-out boring.
quotes.author: Alysha Speer

quotes.quote: I hate the way, once you start to know someone, care about them, their behavior can distress you, even when it's unreasonable and not your fault, even if you were really trying to be careful, tactful.
quotes.author: Tanith Lee,  Wolf Star

quotes.quote: Love doesn't make the world go 'round; love is what makes the ride worthwhile.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Two persons cannot long be friends if they cannot forgive each other's little failings.
quotes.author: Jean de la Bruyere

quotes.quote: Nobody sees a flower - really - it is so small it takes time - we haven't time - and to see takes time, like to have a friend takes time.
quotes.author: Georgia O'Keeffe,  Georgia O'Keeffe

quotes.quote: It's much easier to not know things sometimes. Things change and friends leave. And life doesn't stop for anybody.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: Friendship is one mind in two bodies.
quotes.author: Mencius

quotes.quote: The process of falling in love at first sight is as final as it is swift in such a case, but the growth of true friendship may be a lifelong affair.
quotes.author: Sarah Orne Jewett

quotes.quote: When we honestly ask ourselves which person in our lives means the most to us, we often find that it is those who, instead of giving advice, solutions, or cures, have chosen rather to share our pain and touch our wounds with a warm and tender hand.
quotes.author: Henri Nouwen

quotes.quote: Why are you being so mean?""Friends tell friends the truth.""yeah, but not to hurt, to help.
quotes.author: Laurie Halse Anderson,  Wintergirls

quotes.quote: The most I can do for my friend is simply be his friend.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: You will evolve past certain people. Let yourself.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

quotes.quote: People will walk in and walk out of your life, but the one whose footstep made a long lasting impression is the one you should never allow to walk out.
quotes.author: Michael Bassey Johnson

quotes.quote: A friend to all is a friend to none.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Your job is to focus on my personal happiness, she said, & I've got big plans, so break time is over.
quotes.author: Brian Andreas

quotes.quote: Don't worry if people think you're crazy. You are crazy. You have that kind of intoxicating insanity that lets other people dream outside of the lines and become who they're destined to be.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: Friends can make you feel that the world is smaller and less sneaky than it really is, because you know people who have similar experiences.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  The Austere Academy

quotes.quote: Friends and good manners will carry you where money won't go.
quotes.author: Margaret Walker

quotes.quote: If you claim to be a real friend then be real in your soul. If you claim to be fake then be an enemy instead.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar

quotes.quote: The language of friendship is not words but meanings.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.author: Haruki Murakami

quotes.quote: People leave imprints on our lives, shaping who we become in much the same way that a symbol is pressed into the page of a book to tell you who it comes from. Dogs, however, leave paw prints on our lives and our souls, which are as unique as fingerprints in every way.
quotes.author: Ashly Lorenzana

quotes.quote: I had a dream about you. The seasons changed, but you did not. You were the same old person you always were, only older. And I was the same old person I always was, only younger. quotes.quote: I fantasize the night sky to be like a cosmic blue print of my life as I close my eyes and unbutton my heart.... just in case anyone up there is listening.

quotes.quote: Celebrate true friends. They are a part of you that always sparkles.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.author: Emily Dickinson,  I'm Nobody! Who Are You?

quotes.quote: A true friend freely, advises justly, assists readily, adventures boldly, takes all patiently, defends courageously, and continues a friend unchangeably.
quotes.author: William Penn

quotes.quote: Floating there I held onto faith. Because you can't know who might cross your path or who will take your breath away. You can't know what friends might actually become sisters because they stayed by your side. You can't know when there'll be an unexpected detour that'll take you to the place where you were always meant to be.
quotes.author: Holly C. Corbett,  The Lost Girls: Three Friends. Four Continents. One Unconventional Detour Around the World.

quotes.quote: I've grown up defined by this desperate, undeniable, 'can't breathe' kind of space inside of myself and I'm afraid that the diagnosis is fatal.

quotes.quote: My best friend is the one who brings out the best in me.

quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth

quotes.quote: I'm going to follow this invisible red thread until I find myself again... until I finally figure out... who I'm meant to be.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: In a general sense, I admit to valuing the worldviews of men under the age of 40 and women over the age of 30.

quotes.quote: Happy is the soul that has a friend. Happier is the soul that trusts in the truth of the heart of a friend. Happiest is the soul that knows the solemnity of friendship and honours its laws.

quotes.quote: I have learned that to be with those I like is enough.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.author: Hermann Hesse,  The Glass Bead Game

quotes.quote: Separate yourself from those who hinder your vision. Make a choice to walk away from the trap set to ensnare you. Realize when someone is pulling you backwards every time you take a step forward. Separate from them and the result of your action will be a life of success.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: Something, somewhere, knows what's best for me and promises to keep sending me people and experiences to light my way as long as I live in gratitude and keep paying attention to the signs.

quotes.quote: Let this time in your life cut you open and drain all of the things that are holding you back. I'm going to help you forgive the things that you won't let yourself forget.

quotes.author: Michael Bassey Johnson

quotes.quote: You know you made it, when your friends tell their friends that you are their friend.

quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: If instead of a gem, or even a flower, we should cast the gift of a loving thought into the heart of a friend, that would be giving as the angels give.

quotes.quote: Friendship needs no words - it is solitude delivered from the anguish of loneliness.

quotes.quote: 'This life is what you make it. No matter what, you're going to mess up sometimes, it's a universal truth. But the good part is you get to decide how you're going to mess it up. Girls will be your friends - they'll act like it anyway. But just remember, some come, some go. The ones that stay with you through everything - they're your true best friends. Don't let go of them. Also remember, sisters make the best friends in the world. As for lovers, well, they'll come and go too. And baby, I hate to say it, most of them - actually pretty much all of them are going to break your heart, but you can't give up because if you give up, you'll never find your soulmate. You'll never find that half who makes you whole and that goes for everything. Just because you fail once, doesn't mean you're gonna fail at everything. Keep trying, hold on, and always, always, always believe in yourself, because if you don't, then who will, sweetie? So keep your head high, keep your chin up, and most importantly, keep smiling, because life's a beautiful thing and there's so much to smile about.'
